name: Hylos
title: Grand Warden
story:
Amidst the misty mountains within the northern reaches of the Land of Dawn, resides the ancient and mysterious race of Centaurs, half-man, half-horse creatures. The Centaurs guard a fountain that rests among the highest mountain peak. This fountain is said to give the gift of Immortality and Infinite wisdom. Dark forces have relentlessly tried to gain the power found within the waters of this fountain, but only to be time and time again be thwarted by the centaurs.

However, as time went on, the centaurs became tired and attrition soon took hold. It was not until Hylos had arrived, where he threw his mastery of nature's wrath, he was able to crush and punish all the invaders of the fountain. He had become a legendary figure within the annals of the Land of Dawn.
brief: He lives in the Misty Mountains and belongs to the Centaur race. He has the ability to convert natural magic into life force, and at the same time he can continuously punish any enemy who invades the Misty Mountains by consuming his own life force.
blurb: Centaur guarding the Misty Mountains.

abilities.name: Thickened Blood
abilities.description:
Hylos gains 1.5 extra Max HP for every 1 extra Max Mana he possesses.

When out of Mana, Hylos can use his HP for skill casts.

abilities.name: Law and Order
abilities.description:
Hylos gains 50% Movement Speed and causes his next Basic Attack within 3s to deal 300/350/400/450/500/550 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target, knocking back and stunning them for 1s.

The extra Movement Speed rapidly decays over the duration and vanishes after the next Basic Attack.

abilities.name: Ring of Punishment
abilities.description:
Hylos releases the Ring of Punishment, dealing 100/130/160/190/220/250 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies per second while slowing them by 4/4/5/5/6/6% and reducing their Attack Speed by 7.5/9/10.5/12/13.5/15% for 2.5s (up to 8 stacks). Each stack also increases the enemy's damage taken from the Ring of Punishment by 5/8/11/14/17/20%. The Ring of Punishment consumes 30 Mana per second when it's active.

Use Again: Hylos cancels the Ring of Punishment.

abilities.name: Glorious Pathway
abilities.description:
Hylos creates a huge pathway in the target direction, reducing enemies' Movement Speed by 75% for 1s. The pathway lasts 6s.
When on the pathway, Hylos gains Slow Immunity and recovers 3/4/5% of his Max HP per second. Allied heroes moving along the pathway gain 60/65/70% extra Movement Speed, while enemy heroes on the pathway will be slowed by 25/35/45%.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description:
In teamfights, use Hylos' Ultimate to create a pathway into the enemy team
and then his 1st Skill to get in and stun an enemy. At the same time, use his 2nd Skill and Basic Attacks to deal continuous damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Hylos should use his 1st Skill to get close and stun the enemy, then follow up with his 2nd Skill and Basic Attacks to deal damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description:
Hylos works best with heroes that need faster Movement Speed to engage,
such as Terizla and Minsitthar.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Hylos is strong against heroes without mobility skills that can't easily escape his 2nd Skill, like Layla and Gord.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Hylos is countered by high mobility heroes like Karrie and Lesley, as they are hard for him to lock down and can also take him out.

name: Zhask
title: The King of Swarms
story:
In the vast universe, there are countless unknown planets and mysterious regions.

Some planets have been annihilated and forgotten, but some endure – like the planet of Kastiya.

A long history can often create a great civilization, but this did not change the brutality in Kastiyan's genes. For countless epochs, the Swarm of Kastiya plundered and devoured to maintain the prosperity of their own race. The nature of the Swarm made them keen on endless encroachment and reproduction.

As the king of Kastiya, Zhask knew exactly what he and his race needed. The terrifying Swarm were able to follow Zhask's lead, appearing anywhere in the universe, and then devouring it all. The reproduction of the Swarm was more prolific than the continuation of any race. No planet in known history has ever been completely safe after being invaded by the Swarm - and the most terrifying thing was that the Swarm would never be completely wiped out.

Of course, the Swarm of Kastiya also had their nemesis - Mithlora.

Mitilola was a mysterious region among the stars in the cosmos. The race living there was few in number, but naturally powerful. As one of the most advanced hunters in the universe and a strong race born with power, Mithlora was born to maintain the balance of the universe. Therefore, the Swarm, who could thrive almost anywhere, had to be dealt with.

A veteran hunter from Mithlora destroyed Zhask's home Kastiya, but the Swarm could not be completely destroyed. In fact, after the destruction of their hometown, the Swarm headed by Zhask began to expand wildly and invade various other planets. They enjoyed the pleasure of plundering, the success of reproduction, but at the same time, they were being hunted by a new hunter - Yve from Mithlora.

Zhask was not afraid of this.

On the contrary, he enjoyed the fun of the chase. Even though Kastiya had already been reduced to dust in the universe, Zhask and his Swarm believed that any area in the starry sky may become the Kastiya II- so long as they never stop multiplying.

With great strength and cunning avoidance, Zhask caused Yve's hunts to fail countless times. Because of the

Swarm's strong ability to reproduce, the planets that had been invaded had almost no power to fight back. The creatures on those planets quickly disappeared without a trace under Zhask's plunder, and the process of resistance was short and weak.

Although those from Mithlora never needed help from others, the weakness of those planets did make Yve isolated to a certain extent. Every time Yve traced Zhask's trail, Zhask had already successfully completed his plundering and flown away. Even though Yve was fast enough, she was always a step behind Zhask.

Zhask was immersed in the pleasure of plundering. He enjoyed this kind of thrilling hunt and the endless slaughter. Even in the most thrilling times, Yve caught up with him and inflicted heavy damage on him, but he still escaped under the cover of the Swarm.

The scars on his body would not make Zhask stop his journey. He didn't even give himself breathing time, but once again passed through the gap in time and space and came to a new area.

This time, he came to the Land of Dawn.

The arrival of Zhask and the Swarm brought serious disasters to The Northern Vale on the Land of Dawn. Numerous villages and tribes were destroyed by the Swarm and the people were displaced. But the Land of Dawn was a land where heroes gathered. This time, Zhask encountered unprecedented resistance.

The young knight Tobias led his knights to fight Zhask and sacrificed his life for the peace of the land. His lover Aurora dealt Zhask a heavy blow.

This was the first time that Zhask had been badly hurt by anyone other than Yve. Injured, he could not escape from the Land of Dawn through the Chrono Rift, so he could only find a piece of land on this continent as a temporary stronghold to give him and his Swarm some respite. He never imagined that these seemingly fragile creatures would be so powerful.

He cultivated himself quietly, waiting for the right opportunity. But the situation was a bit tricky: Aurora, who in order to avenge his lover, guarded the Frozen Sea and never left for a minute, and the time and space fluctuations in the universe let Zhask know clearly – Yve would soon arrive.
brief: Zhask expanded his swarm as he pleased in the universe, disrupting its balance in the process. Yve pursued him, but Zhask was able to escape every time. When he shuffled to the Land of Dawn and attempted to destroy it, he was hit hard by the resistance of  Aurora and Tobias, so he hibernated in Kastiya to recuperate. But at this time, Yve also arrived, so a dual was imminent.
blurb: King of the Swarm who disrupts the balance of the universe.

abilities.name: Decimation
abilities.description: Upon death, Zhask summons a frenzied <highlight>Nightmaric Spawn</highlight> on the spot, which gradually loses HP over time until death.

abilities.name: Nightmaric Spawn
abilities.description:
Zhask summons a Nightmaric Spawn that inherits 55/70/85/100% of his Attributes (HP, Hybrid Defense, and Magic Power). Nightmaric Spawn will automatically attack nearby enemies by firing a Death Ray at the target, dealing 55 (+20% extra Attack Speed) (+20% Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by up to 30%. If Zhask is too far away from Nightmaric Spawn, it will disappear.
Death Ray is considered as a Basic Attack but cannot Crit.
Fusion Enhanced: The damage of Nightmaric Spawn is increased to 180%, and it can be repositioned.

abilities.name: Mind Eater
abilities.description:
Zhask fires a penetrating mental missile in the designated direction, dealing 300/380/460/540 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Afterward, Nightmaric Spawn will attack enemies hit by Mind Eater for 120 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stun them for 0.5s.

Fusion Enhanced: Increases the damage dealt by Mind Eater by 540/685/830/975 (+180% Total Magic Power).

abilities.name: Hive Clones
abilities.description:
Zhask releases a swarm of Hive Clones in the targeted direction. The clones will explode and deal 55/70/85/100 (+18% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies on contact, reducing their Movement Speed by 80% for 1s.
If Hive Clones find no target, they will burrow into the ground and ambush enemies passing by.
Fusion Enhanced: Zhask releases several swarms of Hive Clones.
Subsequent damage dealt to the same target decays to 20%.

abilities.name: Dominator's Descent
abilities.description:
Zhask selects a designated position to summon Nightmaric Spawn and fuses with it. Nightmaric Spawn can inherit 100% of his attributes and get extra of them. His skills are enhanced during the fusion period.

Use Again: Zhask immediately gets off Nightmaric Spawn and loses enhancement.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Zhask should start by summoning his Nightmaric Spawn in a suitable location and use his Ultimate to fuse with it, then unleash his enhanced 2nd and 3rd Skill to stun and damage enemies, and follow up with Basic Attacks. If the enemy tries to flee, use his enhanced 1st Skill to blink toward them.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Zhask should start with his 1st Skill to summon a Nightmaric Spawn next to the enemy and follow up with his 2nd Skill to stun the target, then use his 3rd Skill for more damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Zhask works best with heroes that can lock down enemies so he can have more time to deal damage, like Belerick and Lolita.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Zhask is strong against burst damage heroes like Aldous and Paquito because his high HP after fusing with his Nightmaric Spawn, makes him tough to burst down.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Zhask is countered by agile or long range heroes, such as Pharsa and Cecilion, because they can quickly step out of range of his immobile Nightmaric Spawn.

name: Helcurt
title: Shadowbringer
story:
They were traitors the moment they were born.

In the darkest depths of the Abyss, the Styx Clan once bared their fangs against the Lord of the Abyss.

The Styx Clan were the deadliest hunters to roam the shadows, born to spread the darkness. They could stalk their enemies for days in complete silence before finally slitting their throats and vanishing into the night. Their talents made them the most feared assassins of the Abyss. But even more terrifying was their beast-like nature, because when survival is at stake, there is no predicting what a beast would do.

"Survive..."

Confronted with the Styx Clan's rebellion, even the mighty Lord of the Abyss felt fear. But he could not allow such transgressions against the name of the darkness.

Against the sheer power of the Lord of the Abyss, the Styx Clan was defeated. They were branded as traitors and suffered a most cruel punishment: they were "gifted" the Lord of the Abyss's blood, to be forever shackled to his will. This not only physically prevented them from raising their claws against the Lord of the Abyss, but also served as the greatest form of humiliation. The beasts of the Abyss were thus tamed like dogs.

Helcurt was the offspring of this clan of traitors. He was born in the midst of the great war and witnessed his kin being used as cannon fodder. Their broken bodies filled the battlefields, and eventually, it would be his turn.

"Survive..."

The only thought going through Helcurt's mind was to survive. He ran and fought with all his might across the battlefield, and emerged victorious from the merciless meat grinder. After the battle, he was summoned by the Lord of the Abyss. Seeing Helcurt's short, feral stature, the Lord mockingly declared that Helcurt was the "most loyal dog" of his clan, and placed him in the Tribunal to judge and execute traitors.

"You wretched thing. do as I will and you'll get your share of scraps."

Helcurt obeyed. The first traitor judged was one of his clansmen. A veil of darkness shrouded his path that night. and amidst the fearful expressions from his kin, Helcurt slit the traitors throat with a flash of the blade, fulfilling his mission. The blood flowed silently as he dropped the lifeless body. He carried out the execution without hesitation, but in that instant, he experienced an eternity of anguish.

"Survive..."

He was born with the stigma of a traitor, and now he must live up to that name and hunt his own. He became the Blade of the Tribunal, slaughtering his brethren who had betrayed the Lord of the Abyss, even if they were only trying to survive. No one knew what Helcurt was thinking on these hunts. All he knew was that he had to live on. Though he was born in the darkness, walked in the darkness, and shall forever remain in the darkness, he was still alive.

In the murky swamps where he could alone, Helcurt marked each passing year by tying a knot on a rope. This was his proof that he was alive. Living was his most humble and proud desire, even if he did so like a dog in the shadows......

Helcurt had survived to see the end of the war, but with the absence of the gods. madness to spread through the Abyss. The source of it all was the Lord of the Abyss, who had lost his way without his dark god, For thousands of years, he controlled the Abyss using his corrupted blood, and now his madness infected them in the same manner. This was the 310CX-i Curse. Left with no choice, the demons of the Abyss, led by Thamuz. turned against the Lord of the Abyss, They surged toward the Lord of the Abyss's palace. and Helcurt. leading the Tribunal, stood as the last line of defense like an imposing wall.

Amidst the chaos, Helcurt gripped his tightly.

"A thousand knots, a thousand years...'

The coarse feel of the reminded him that he was still alive.

Though born in the darkness, born a traitor, he had the right to live.

"Survive..."

Helcurt turned around and came face to face With the towering Lord of the Abyss before emitting a beastly roar. With all his might, he purged the cursed blood and caused It to burst out of his body. The sheer force caused his bones to jet out from his skin like blades. In an instant, he was on top of the Lord of the Abyss, slashing away with his blades of one, freeing himself from the shackles of the Blood Curse in a most fitting fashion.

"When you decided my fate, you should have remembered that I was born a traitor..."

He had bared his tangs against the Lord of the Abyss. Just like his ancestors a thousand years ago.

He was born a traitor.

He had always been a traitor.
brief: Born into the Styx Clan of the Abyss, Helcurt bore the stigma of his clan's betrayal against the Sovereign of the Abyss. Yet he joined the Tribunal, executing traitors for the very same Sovereign-even his own kin. The Styx Clan had betrayed their master, but in order to survive, Helcurt would even betray his own people. And when the clans of the Abyss rose against the Sovereign, it was Helcurt who struck the fatal blow... Indeed, he was born in darkness and walked among darkness. A traitor by birth, however, even a traitor has the right to live. He will survive, and no one will stop him.
blurb: The nightmare of the Abyss who's willing to betray anyone in order to survive.

abilities.name: Shadow of Styx
abilities.description:
Helcurt remains in Prowler state until spotted by the enemy team, gaining 15% extra Movement Speed, and continuously regenerating (+30% Total Physical Attack) HP if he has not dealt any damage.
He gains 50% extra Attack Speed and 50% extra Movement Speed (decreasing over time) for 4s upon being spotted and leaves Prowler state 0.75s later.
Any hero killed after being hit by Helcurt leaves a dark fog that explodes and spreads with a cooldown of 10s. Helcurt Conceals himself while within the dark fog.
abilities.flavor_text: He who hides in the shadow.

abilities.name: Hidden Terror
abilities.description:
Passive: When Helcurt is in Prowler state, the skill terrifies enemy heroes hit and briefly reveals them. Its cooldown decreases 3 times as fast as normal.

Active: Helcurt blinks to the target location and deals 150/180/210/240/270/300 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within the area, reducing their Movement Speed by 60% for 0.75s.
abilities.flavor_text: He who patrols the dark.

abilities.name: Deadly Stinger
abilities.description:
Passive: Helcurt gains one Deadly Stinger for every 1.5s spent in Prowler state or on each Basic Attack. Up to 5 stingers can be stored.
Active: Helcurt fires all Deadly Stingers forward, each dealing 180/200/220/240/260/280 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies (Minions and Creeps take only 70% of the damage).
Deadly Stinger counts as a Basic Attack but cannot Crit.
abilities.flavor_text: He who awaks in the slaughter.

abilities.name: Dark Night Falls
abilities.description:
Helcurt summons the Dark Night, reducing all enemies' sight range and making them lose sight of their allies for 3s. During Dark Night, Helcurt gains 40/45/50% extra Movement Speed.

The Dark Night makes it easier for Helcurt to leave enemies' sight range.
abilities.flavor_text: He who resurrects in the night.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, cast Helcurt's Ultimate to obscure the enemies' vision, then blink to their backline with his 1st Skill to hit with his Basic Attacks, and end with his 2nd Skill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, blink to the target using Helcurt's 1st Skill, then stack up stingers with his Basic Attacks and finish the combo with his 2nd Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Helcurt's Ultimate is a great tool to obscure the enemy's vision and makes it easier for him and his team to engage. Additionally, heroes with CC like Tigreal, Esmeralda, and Terizla work great with Helcurt to secure kills.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Helcurt can swiftly approach enemies with his mobility and quickly take down heroes like Layla, Chang'e, and Vale with his burst damage.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Helcurt should avoid tank heroes that he can't burst down, such as Fredrinn, Belerick, and Gatotkaca. Once Helcurt is caught by their CC, they can make short work of him with their teammates.

name: Pharsa
title: Wings of Vengeance
story:
The Crow people of Askati Forest are one of the oldest races to still exist in the Land of Dawn. This race was united by the Crow King, Osana, under whose venerable leadership they perfected the art of Sky Magic. This unique school of magic allows its wielder to transform into a bird, soar across the skies, and grants the ability to strike from enormous distances, however, only those who have had their blood "awakened" can use it.

The noble Princess Pharsa was born with an unknown type of blood which was said to hold enormous potential if awakened, but as hard as they tried, the baffled people of her tribe failed to unleash its true power. Soon enough, Pharsa’s special blood became a burden, as ill-intentioned opportunists from across the land sought to reap it for their own benefit. On the day of Pharsa’s wedding, the tyrannical witch, Alice invaded the Askati Forest, mercilessly slaying countless Crows and leaving a smoldering trail of ruin in her wake. Numbed to the core by the carnage surrounding her, Pharsa dropped Osana's ancient crown to the floor. Her appearance began to change, as unprecedented power coursed through her veins—her blood had been awakened. Pharsa’s eyes clouded over, as one side of her hair turned pure white, and she soared into the sky to unleash a torrential assault of horrifying magical power, fierce enough to drive Alice away.

Verri, the love of her life, couldn’t bear to see his betrothed suffer a life of blindness alone, and chose to accompany Pharsa wherever she went, utilizing his own magic to become permanently linked to Pharsa, and allowing her to see through his eyes. Pharsa wishes her power had never been awakened, she wishes even more that her home had not been destroyed, but that witch took everything from her, and now it was time for revenge...
brief: As princess of the Crow Clan of Askati Forest, she was born with mutated blood. The mutation could gain her amazing abilities if she is awakened. When Alice invaded Askati Forest, the awakened Pharsa drove Alice away and lost her eyesight. After that, her lover turned himself into a crow to replace her eyes.
blurb: Crow Princess of Askati Forest.

abilities.name: Spiritual Unity
abilities.description: Every 5 to 8s (varies with <highlight>Feathered Air Strike</highlight> level), Verri enters the Hunting state and assists Pharsa on her next attack against an enemy hero, dealing extra <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> equal to 8% of the target's Max HP (+ 1% for every 200 Magic Power owned) and slowing them by 60% for 1s.

abilities.name: Curse of Crow
abilities.description:
Pharsa unleashes a blast of magic at the target location, dealing 300/325/350/375/400/425 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and marking them for 4s.

When Pharsa hits a marked enemy with a Basic Attack or active skill, the mark is consumed to stun them for 1s.
Marked enemies have their position revealed.

abilities.name: Energy Impact
abilities.description: Pharsa releases magic energy in the target direction, dealing 475/520/565/610/655/700<scaleAP> (+145% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies hit.

abilities.name: Feathered Air Strike
abilities.description:
Passive: Each level-up reduces Spiritual Unity's interval by 1s.
Active: Pharsa takes flight for 8s and bombards the target location, dealing 530/700/870 (+160% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within the area. This skill can be cast up to 4 times within the duration.

abilities.name: Wings by Wings
abilities.description: Pharsa turns into mist and wraps herself around Verri, gaining 150% extra Movement Speed (decaying over time) and the ability to fly over terrain. This state lasts up to 5s or until she uses a Basic Attack or skills, or is controlled.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Pharsa can use her 4th Skill to get into an advantageous position to initiate a teamfight, followed by a damage combo with her 1st and 3rd skills and use her 2nd Skill when she wants to deal extra damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Pharsa should start with her 1st Skill to mark the enemy, follow up with her 2nd Skill to apply CC, and then cast her Ultimate to deal an insane amount of Magic Damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Pharsa is best with heroes who can CC the enemy so that her skills can hit them. Atlas and Franco are good examples of this.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Pharsa can deal high burst damage from a very long range. A great counter to enemy back-row heroes with poor Mobility, such as Layla, Hanabi and Xavier.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Pharsa should beware of any displacement ability skill. Heroes like Franco, Zilong and Minsitthar can easily interrupt Pharsa's Ultimate.

name: Lesley
title: Deadly Sniper
story:
Lesley grew up in the Vance household, where her father presided over the noble family's security. During an attack by a rival family, Lesley's father was killed. As the assailants approached the Vance household, Lesley took up her father's black long rifle and fulfilled her late father's mission. Tears rolled down Lesley's cheeks as she fired shot after shot, each one taking down an assassin. The final tear came as the final shot took down the last of the rival family's men.

Lesley was adopted by the Vance family, with the patriarch of the noble house even putting their sole heir, Harley, under her tutelage. Harley was a natural troublemaker who used his talents in magic to cause trouble for the Vance household. Only Lesley could keep Harley under control. Harley's troublemaker streak was the last part of warmth within Lesley's conscience.

After hearing about how Harley had travelled to the dangerous Land of Dawn, Lesley followed along with her trusty heirloom rifle. After a long arduous journey, she found that Harley, the once immature young boy, had changed through the numerous life experiences he had endured. She decided it would be best to have her adopted little brother train here, while she silently protects him from the shadows. From that day on, all the monsters that were inflicted with Harley's magic would also be struck with a black bullet. Stories of the magical youngster that was followed by a mysterious black sniper soon spread.
brief: After the death of her father, she was adopted by House Vance and became Harley's sister. Lesley regarded her younger brother as everything to her, and kept protecting Harley secretly.
blurb: Adopted daughter of House Vance, a clandestine sniper.

abilities.name: Lethal Shot
abilities.description:
If Lesley doesn't take damage for 5s, her next Basic Attack gains extra range and 50% Crit Chance and deals 100 (+100% Total Physical Attack) True Damage (20% extra damage against minions).
Each point of fixed Physical Penetration and each 1% Physical Penetration Lesley acquires is converted into 1% Crit Damage, but her base Crit Damage is reduced to 130%.
Lesley's Basic Attack restores 5 points of energy and her Lethal Shot doubles the amount of energy restored. The Lethal Shot effect will activate immediately after Lesley uses a skill.

abilities.name: Master of Camouflage
abilities.description:
Lesley enters the Camouflage state, gaining double Energy Regen, 40% extra Movement Speed, and 85/90/95/100/105/110 extra Physical Attack.

The state lasts 3s or until Lesley takes or deals damage. Enemies can detect Lesley's position through distortions of their surroundings.

abilities.name: Tactical Grenade
abilities.description:
Lesley throws a tactical grenade in the target direction while jumping back slightly, dealing 150/180/210/240/270/300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and knocking them back.

Lesley can cast this skill during Ultimate Snipe to cancel the state and immediately fire a Fatal Bullet at the target. The attack is only triggered when there are unfired Fatal Bullets left.

abilities.name: Ultimate Snipe
abilities.description:
Lesley locks onto the target enemy hero and fires 4 Fatal Bullets in succession, each dealing Physical Damage equal to 250/300/350 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) plus 5% of their lost HP and restoring 10 energy on hit. The Bullets can be blocked by other enemy heroes.

If this skill is interrupted, each remaining Bullet reduces the skill cooldown by 10%.

Passive: Lesley's Crit Chance is increased by 10%.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Lesley can repeatedly use her 1st Skill to deal more damage with her enhanced Basic Attack while moving. When the enemy hero is close, Lesley can use her 2nd Skill and the enhanced Basic Attack for the counterattack, and use his Ultimate to start reaping.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, once Lesley reaches full energy, and her enhanced Basic Attack is activated, wait for the opportunity to use the enhanced Basic Attack to hit the enemy hero. Then use her 1st Skill to reactivate the enhanced Basic Attack and hit the enemy again, and finally, use her Ultimate to finish off the enemy.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Lesley works best with tank heroes who can provide better attacking conditions for her, like Minotaur and Baxia.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Lesley is strong against tank heroes who rely heavily on equipment. Because her attacks can deal True Damage that will ignore the defense these heroes get from the equipment. Such as Gatotkaca and Fredrinn.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Lesley is countered by Assassin heroes with multiple movement abilities, which will cause her to lose her range advantage. Such as Ling and Lancelot.

name: Jawhead
title: Steel Sweetheart
story:
Clandestine organizations have existed throughout the many ages of the Land of Dawn's history. No one knows the true purpose of these organizations, but one thing is for sure: whenever a crisis is at hand, mysterious figures emerge from the shadows to restore order to the world.

Professor Henry and his wife worked for the Dawn Council, known for its research in cutting-edge technology, providing an endless and varied stream of high-tech products to government agencies and mysterious, anonymous clients. But when they finally finished developing the "SMART-01", all this changed, as their new creation was more intelligent and powerful than any android the world had seen before. It was designed so that once a genetically matched host controlled him, he could act according to the controller's consciousness. The leaders of the Dawn Council saw the potential of this technology for warfare and ordered the Henrys to transfer the technology to selected government agencies for a mass production program. The Henrys refused.

After ordering their Prototype One to destroy all of the experiment's data, the Henrys mysteriously disappeared. To this day, little Ailee has no knowledge of these events. All she knows and cares about is that this special robot has always been there to protect and accompany her, and that he calls her "Honey" like her father once did, while she affectionately calls him "Jawhead" in return. The only clue left behind by her parents was a pocket watch she carries with her wherever she goes. Eventually, Ailee decides to journey with her robot friend to track down her parents' whereabouts...
brief: This intelligent robot developed by Henry and his wife is armed with weapons and strong defensive capabilities, and can also act as a housekeeper. It is responsible for protecting the couple's daughter little Ailee after their disappearance.
blurb: Intelligent robot used to protect little Ailee.

abilities.name: Mecha Suppression
abilities.description: Each time Jawhead deals damage to an enemy hero or a Creep, he inflicts a stack of Mecha Suppression on them for 3s (up to 6 stacks). Each stack of Mecha Suppression increases all damage dealt to the target by 2% (limited to 50% for Creeps).

abilities.name: Smart Missiles
abilities.description: Jawhead launches up to 12 missiles at random nearby enemies over 5s, each missile dealing 135/160/185/210/235/260<scaleAD> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to the enemy hit.

abilities.name: Ejector
abilities.description:
Jawhead gains 30% Movement Speed and a 500/600/700/800/900/1000 (+100% Total Physical Attack) shield for 5s.

Use Again: Jawhead flings the nearest unit (prioritizes heroes) to the target location, dealing 300/340/380/420/460/500 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for 0.5s. Can be used on allied heroes and they will not take damage.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Force
abilities.description: Jawhead charges into the target enemy hero, dealing 350/475/600<scaleAD> (+150% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and briefly stunning them. Enemies around the target are knocked back and dealt the same amount of damage. Jawhead is immune to control effects during the charge.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Jawhead's 2nd Skill for the Movement Speed and start up his 1st Skill then immediately charge into a target using his Ultimate. Finally, use his 2nd Skill to toss the enemy back.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Jawhead works best with heroes that benefit from a quick engage like Odette and Belerick because he can throw them into the enemy for a surprise attack.

relationships.title: strong

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Jawhead is countered by heroes with high sustained damage or high survivability, like Edith and Thamuz, because they can survive Jawhead's burst damage and beat him in a prolonged battle.

name: Angela
title: Bunnylove
story:
Dr. Baker was one of the founders of Lab 1718, an institution created with the aim of bringing peace to the world. But as his co-founders fell deeper and deeper into their depraved human weaponization experiments, Dr. Baker felt he had no choice but to leave and pursue a new project. Renouncing the questionable ethics of human experimentation, he endeavored to create a new kind of lifeform, solely from a mechanical skeleton, puppet strings, and synthetic skin, and finally, a new generation of artificial life was born. Dr. Baker firmly believed that love and hope were the greatest inventions of mankind, so he programmed the world's most moving stories into the heart of his new creation.

One bright morning, Peace Android Prototype 1 awakened from her bed, and Dr. Baker bestowed upon this adorable mechanical angel, the name Angela. Angela followed Dr. Baker's tutelage, studying hard to understand the world, and hoping to meet the doctor's high expectations. However, their peaceful life together was soon cut short. When the mad scientists of Lab 1718 heard rumors that Dr. Baker had created a living soul outside of a human body, they couldn't believe it. They convinced themselves that Baker had betrayed them, keeping this knowledge to himself before fleeing, and so they ordered Dr. Baker's past creations, Alpha and Beta, to hunt down Dr. Baker and Angela. As their pursuers were just about to close in on them, Dr. Baker placed Angela into a flight capsule, instructing her to seek out his good friend Dr. Rooney.

However, the flight capsule was struck down in a terrible thunderstorm, and landed in a remote corner of the Land of Dawn. Emerging from the wreckage, Angela began her journey to find Dr. Rooney and save her father.
brief: An android created by the founder of Laboratory 1718, Dr. Baker. It was the first life form created without using human body or soul. In order to gain the knowledge of her, other scientists in the lab went after Dr. Baker. Before taken away, Dr. Baker stuffed her into a flight capsule to escape.
blurb: Artificial human made in Laboratory 1718.

abilities.name: Smart Heart
abilities.description: Angela gains 5% extra Movement Speed for 4s each time she casts a skill (up to 30%). When she's attached to an allied hero, the Movement Speed boost is transferred to the allied hero.

abilities.name: Love Waves
abilities.description:
Angela sends Love Waves in the target direction, dealing 170/200/230/260/290/320 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit, revealing their positions briefly, and applying a stack of Lover's Mark (up to 5 stacks). Each stack of Lover's Mark increases the damage by 20% and slows enemies hit by 8% for 3s.

Love Waves also restore 150/160/170/180/190/200 (+75% Total Magic Power) HP to allied heroes hit. Angela can store up to 5 charges of this skill and the recharge time is affected by Cooldown Reduction.

When attached to allies, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 60%.

abilities.name: Puppet-on-a-String
abilities.description:
Angela launches a Puppet String at the target enemy, dealing 300/330/360/390/420/450 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and gradually slowing them by up to 80%. If the enemy is still connected to the string after 3s, they'll be immobilized for 1.5s and dealt 450/495/540/585/630/675 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

Each stack of Lover's Mark increases the final damage by 20%.

abilities.name: Heartguard
abilities.description:
Angela begins channeling, applying a 600/800/1000 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield to the target allied hero regardless of distance. After the channeling is complete, she attaches herself to the allied hero for 20s, during which she can cast skills at zero Mana cost.
Angela can cast this skill again to cancel the channeling or detach herself from the allied hero. The attaching state will end early if the allied hero is killed.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Angela's Ultimate first to attach to a strong ally, and use her 1st Skill to deal damage or heal allies when needed. When enemies try to close in, CC them with her 2nd Skill, and follow up with her 1st Skill for sustained damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Angela's 1st Skill to constantly poke the enemy. When their HP is low, use her 2nd Skill to CC the target, then continue to deal damage with her 1st Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Angela works best with highly mobile Assassins such as Lancelot and Aamon since she can provide CC and heals while increasing their mobility even further.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Angela counters heroes with low mobility, such as Uranus and Belerick, by slowing them even further and speeding up her allies.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Angela is countered by nimble Assassins with burst damage, such as Ling and Harley.

name: Gusion
title: Holy Blade
story:
House Paxley ruled over Castle Aberleen in the south of Moniyan. Generations of the house had guarded these areas for the Moniyan Empire, defending against the invasion of the abyss.

Around a thousand years ago, House Paxley was granted the dukedom during the rule of the legendary mage Valentina.

Many horrifying stories were told across the Moniyan Empire about House Paxley's use of forbidden magic, and so people would shy away from any Paxley they met.

But Gusion Paxley was an exception.

He was naturally good with blades and daggers, and before he could speak, he had been able to accurately hit his nanny in the forehead with a toy dagger to get back at her for disciplining him. And when he started to read and write, the quill pen dipped in ink would always fly toward the back of his personal tutor's head as if it had eyes.

His unruly behaviours continued until his eldest brother Aamon took over the dukedom – the young Gusion was showing off his dagger skills at the party when he accidentally missed his target, the dagger instead leaving a deep cut on Aamon's face.

Aamon didn't blame his reckless younger brother, but the word soon spread across the Moniyan Empire that the fourth child in House Paxley was a blade wielder – for the Paxley family that had been famed for their magic skills, only lower-class citizens who didn't know magic would fight with daggers and swords.

The Paxley elders who actually controlled the family soon ordered that Gusion must stop playing with daggers and focus on practicing magic. And Gusion did in fact inherit the family's talent in magic, he had a strong affinity for the element of light and quickly awakened his potential while learning magic. But he abhorred memorizing tedious spells and writing complicated scroll. When the other students were researching magic indoors all day, Gusion was powering himself up with sunlight so that he would run faster than a leopard, or using the candlelight to move dinner knives and cut a whole table's dishes into pieces.

Gusion was the only upper-class student who would talk with servants in their family academy, and he was a naughty but likable kid, so the maids would always cover for his nonstop violation of the rules; even when he was kept in solitary confinement, the guards would pretend they didn’t see the desserts that the male servants snuck under the door...

Finally, those exasperated elders asked the young Aamon to discipline his hopeless brother, Gusion hoped that his brother would be on his side, but Aamon instead started lecturing him as the leader of the family.

Gusion was disappointed and completely ignored his brother's lecturing, while deep down feeling sorry for the big brother that used to be close to him – Aamon in front of him was clearly one of the elders, only younger...

And during their dinner together, Aamon persuaded Gusion to follow the family traditions and accept magic training, as Valentina, the first duchess of their family, was a great mage herself. Aamon also told Gusion that he could become an assassin like him, turning magic into sharp blades.

Gusion felt strongly reluctant and asked instead: “Can't a Paxley become an assassin that fights with blades?”

Aamon had no better choice but to say: “As a noblemen, you will have to hide what you really like sometimes...”

Gusion looked at his brother and spoke no further.

A few years later, on his coming-of-age ceremony – a family fighting contest, the 18-year-old Gusion appeared on the arena in a unique style: he used bizarre, fancy moves to dodge the projectiles shot by the other young mages, while his swift and mysterious dagger accurately hit his opponents before they could even cast their spells. The elders of House Paxley were amazed – Gusion was an unconventional blade wielder, but he was indeed using magic powers to control the dagger...

The other young mages lost to Gusion began to accuse him of “cheating”, but he instead provoked them further, claiming that those who felt unfair could challenge him together, as he was able to defeat ten pretentious Paxley mages!

The provoked contestants swarmed toward him, when Gusion suddenly used a move that no one had seen before – he swung his arm and sent daggers flying toward the fan-shaped area in front, hitting all the enemies charging at him. Then he jumped on the spectator stand, before throwing a dagger at the statue of the House Paxley ancestor Valentina and hitting it on the forehead to provoke the others!

“This is what you want – it’s just like the motto of House Paxley: Fear over love.”

After Gusion shouted out the angry words, the exasperated elders began chanting spells, trying to punish the rebel in House Paxley with magic. Aamon, who had remained silent, then stood out and announce loudly: Gusion was to be expelled from the family for seriously violating their rules!

Now that Aamon expelled his brother, the elders that were prepared to kill Gusion had to stop their dark magic spells, watching as Gusion strode out of the arena without sparing them a glance.

What would his future be like? Gusion had never thought about it. He felt a heavy weight off his shoulders, confident that with his abilities he would one day make his name across the Land of Dawn.

Aamon thought to himself as he watched Gusion walk away: “What I can do is to give back your freedom...”
brief: Although he was born into the most powerful magic family on the continent, Gusion is not interested in magic. He is keen to draw inspiration from the holy light to develop new fighting skills. In the end, Gusion left the family.
blurb: Rebellious son of House Paxley.

abilities.name: Dagger Specialist
abilities.description: Each skill cast adds a rune to Gusion's dagger (stacks up to 4 times). Each stack enhances Gusion's next Basic Attack to deal additional damage equal to 3% of the target's Max HP and restore 50<scaleAP> (+25% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> HP to himself.

abilities.name: Sword Spike
abilities.description:
Gusion throws a dagger in the target direction, dealing 200/220/240/260/280/300 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and marking them.

Use Again: Gusion moves behind the marked enemy, dealing 200/220/240/260/280/300 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to them. This skill cannot be interrupted while Gusion is moving behind the marked enemy.

abilities.name: Shadowblade Slaughter
abilities.description:
Gusion throws a volley of daggers in the target direction, each dealing 100/120/140/160/180/200 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 6% for 2s (when hit by multiple daggers, the slow effect can stack up to 30%).

Use Again: Gusion recalls the daggers, each dealing 65/75/85/95/105/115 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path.

abilities.name: Incandescence
abilities.description:
Gusion dashes to the target location, resetting the cooldowns of Sword Spike and Shadowblade Slaughter. If Shadowblade Slaughter was cast once before the reset, Gusion can throw another five daggers on his next Shadowblade Slaughter cast, and recall a total of ten daggers afterward.

Use Again: Gusion dashes a short distance in the target direction.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Gusion should first use his 2nd Skill for damage, then his Ultimate to reset the cooldown for his 2nd Skill. Follow up with his 2nd and 1st Skill combo for more damage. And use his 2nd Skill again to recall all 10 daggers right after moving behind a target with his 1st Skill for massive damage. He can then finish off any remaining low-HP heroes and escape with his Ultimate.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Gusion can use his 1st Skill to mark the enemies, then use his 2nd Skill to slow them down. Next, he can use his 1st Skill again to move behind a target enemy and use his 2nd Skill again to deal massive damage. And finally, use his Basic Attacks to finish off the target.

relationships.title: assist

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Gusion is strong against squishy heroes who lack movement abilities, so that Gusion can easily chase them down. Like Layla and Hanabi.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Gusion is countered by tank heroes with good single-target CC. Once controlled by them, Gusion will have a hard time escaping. Such as Franco and Kaja.

name: Valir
title: Son of Flames
story:
In the southwest of the Land of Dawn lies an active volcano that brought deadly peril to all who dared approach. "Inferno of Fire", was what people called this place. It was also known as the place of trial for Mages eager to master flame spells. After leaving the magic academy, Valir dwelled himself there for five years while carrying a ten-year promise with Vale. He hoped that day would come more quickly, but at the same time, he also hoped that day would never come. One day, Valir cast his arcane flame magic towardsthe volcano but the result was not to his expectation.

In the western desert, there was a man who was looking for Valir. The betrayal of years was something he could never forgive. With great anger and hate, and to maintain the reputation of the magic academy, he decided to track down the traitor. The moment he felt an unusual arcane power releasing from the volcano, he smiled.

The long-term inhabitance in this "Inferno of Fire" brought changes to Valir's body. His skin was burned by the flames of the volcano, but in order to become the Son of Flames, he had to combine the power of his arcane flame magic with the volcano's inferno fire. His body and his will must withstand the trials of these scalding lava. Suddenly, a strong wind blew, bringing a familiar sense to Valir. Vale had come! They had never met each other since childhood. This encounter led to the first fight between them, between fire and wind. The Windtalker and the Son of Flames cast their all magic to attack each other. No words were exchanged, but they shared a common thought - they didn't want to kill each other. However, their fight generated great power, which was aggravated the volcano. If the volcano burst, they would surely die in an inferno.

Five years left - can't you wait Vale!?

Before Vale said anything, Valir heard another familiar voice, it was Gord. Gord's presence interrupted this fight between these brothers. He wanted to abolish the arcane magic of Valir, because in his mind, his pure arcane wisdom should never be tarnished. However, the arcane spell he cast to Valir was stopped by Vale. Vale turned to sympathy upon looking at Valir's tortured body. He didn't want anyone to hurt hisbrother. However, Valir didn't need such sympathy.

One of them was his master who wanted to destroy his apprentice for his apparent betrayal. Another one of them had been his closest brother. However, he was also the son of the one who killed Valir's father. The sacred flame would never be quenched. Valirsuccessfully combined the power of his arcane flame magic with the inferno fire and burst out a powerful energy. With this power, the lava became unstable. Meanwhile, Valir gained a mighty body while his eyes became scarlet flames. At that time, Vale could understand his father's worries. This kind of power astonished Gord, and as his teacher, he would rather kill his student than to let him be possessed by this crazy power.

Valir's flame, Vale's wind, and Gord's arcane power aggravated the volcano, which led to a great collapse. After that, Vale and Gord tried to find Valir, but they couldn't find him. Vale knew that in his heart Valir was still alive, and that their ten-year promise was not yet broken. The five-years made Valir formidable, what was to happen after another five years? Vale knew the next time they encountered each other, it would no longer be as friends and brothers. Rather, it would be about the greatest fight for their lives.
brief: In his hometown of Agelta, he showed an amazing talent for arcane energy manipulation when he first arrived at the Magic Academy, so he was valued by his mentor Gord. But Gord got very angry when he discovered that he had incorporated the spells of his hometown into the arcane, thinking that he had defiled the arcane. After a battle between the master and the disciple, Valir left the Magic Academy.
blurb: Heir to Fire Throat, fire mage.

abilities.name: Ashing
abilities.description:
Valir's skills apply a stack of Ablaze to enemies hit, dealing them Magic Damage equal to 1 (+0.2% Total Magic Power)% of their Max HP per second for 3s.
At 3 stacks, the fire detonates, dealing Magic Damage equal to 5 (+1% Total Magic Power)% of the target's Max HP to the enemy and stunning them for 1s (the same target can only be stunned by Valir's skills once every 7s.)

abilities.name: Burst Fireball

Valir launches a fireball that explodes upon hitting the first target, dealing 235/270/305/340/375/410 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by 30% for 1s. The lingering flame on the ground will explode after 1s, dealing 118/135/153/170/188/205 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Valir recharges 1 fireball every 9/8.6/8.2/7.8/7.4/7s and can hold up to 2 fireball charges. Hitting an enemy hero or Legend Creep with this skill will immediately restore a fireball charge, while hitting a Minion will restore 4 of the recharge time.
Once enhanced by Vengeance Flame, the cast range of Burst Fireball increases by 30%.

abilities.name: Searing Torrent
abilities.description:
Valir unleashes a torrent of flames in the target direction, dealing 200/220/240/260/280/300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and knocking them to the end of its path.
Vengeance Flame: The torrent forms a firewall at the end of its path that lasts 4s and deals 100/110/120/130/140/150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies per second.
Enemies hit by the torrent or the firewall are slowed by 25% for 1s.

abilities.name: Vengeance Flame
abilities.description: Valir removes all existing debuffs on him, gains 40% Movement Speed that decays over 3s, and conjures 4 <highlight>Vengeance Flames</highlight>, enhancing <highlight>Burst Fireball</highlight> and <highlight>Searing Torrent</highlight> for 9s.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, activate Valir's Ultimate to enhance his skills, then blast the enemy with his 1st Skill. If the enemy tries to get close, use his 2nd Skill to push them away, and hit them with his 1st Skill for high damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description:
In the laning phase, harass enemies with Valir's 1st Skill
until their HP is low, then cast his 2nd Skill to push them back and follow up immediately with his 1st Skill for burst damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Teaming up with Fighters with strong initiation like Khaleed and Yu Zhong can simultaneously enhance the entire team's combat potential.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Valir excels in both sustained damage and Crowd Control. He counters heroes lacking mobility like Balmond and Fredrinn.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Valir is countered by agile Assassins like Lancelot and Fanny because they can easily evade his 1st Skill.

name: Martis
title: Ashura King
story:
The Shura clan have thrived in isolation for countless generations, in the Arcapada universe. Their men, renowned for being the world's bravest fighters, and their women famed for being the world's greatest beauties. At the heart of the Shura clan's beliefs lies the legend of the Three Thousand Worlds. The legends speaks of three thousand secret worlds, which upon entering, one must face various levels of psychic and physical trials and advance to world after world upon victory. The people of the Shura clan had discovered a way to enter these worlds, and only those who have conquered over three hundred worlds could be granted the title of Asura, raising them to the level of a demigod in the eyes of their people. However, in the innumerable eons of Shura history, none managed to conquer the fabled three thousand world, until Martis appeared.

With ambition and determination capable of shaking the very heavens, Martis trained every day of his life to become stronger, tirelessly advancing through the secret worlds, each personal breakthrough against the legions of demons granting him a sense of unique personal satisfaction. No one knew how many years passed before Martis reached the final and most hard core secret world. However, his desire for glory drove him onward. After numerous defeats, he fell into despair, but even then, he refused to give up. He transformed his sheer thirst for victory into his twin blades of righteous fury, now known as the Asura's Teeth, and for countless days and nights, battled against the demons of the final world with strength and determination that had never been seen before on the mortal plane. He finally became the first Asura to defeat the three thousand secret worlds and has ever since been regarded as the 'Asura King', ruling, more than tens of milions of aspiring Asura.

name: Uranus
title: Aesthereal Defender
story:
The Celestial Palace - legend has it that the city floating above the skies of the Land of Dawn was once home to the Gods. It is also rumored that this mysterious place holds the key to ruling the world. Eons ago, the ruler of the Celestial Palace utilized the technological secret of the ancients to create Uranus, then commanded it to guard the city and await the emergence of a new ruler.

When the scholars of the Land of Dawn found and opened the gates to the Celestial Palace, the battle between the Dawn Zenith and the Dark Abyss quickly spread throughout the realm, disrupting the solitude of the ancient city. The two forces sought to occupy the Celestial Palace as a symbol of victory, their heroes unleashing the full extent of their power and finally reaching an impasse. The massive influx of energy generated throughout the incessant battles eventually awakened the city's defense system, converting the released energy into pure lightning, fed into Uranus and reawakened after dormancy within the depths of the Celestial Palace. "Leave now, intruders!" he roared upon awakening, charging into the battlefield fueled by lightning, aether and ready to fulfill his destiny. His goal - to purge these savage intruders that had disturbed the tranquility of the Celestial Palace.

It is also rumored that this mysterious place holds the key to ruling the world. Uranus's Basic Attacks deal (+80% Total Physical Attack) (+ 4-8 × Radiance stacks) Magic Damage (increases with level).

abilities.name: Transcendent Ward

Uranus charges to the target location, dealing 80/104/128/152/176/200 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way, and 160/208/256/304/352/400 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies at the target location and slowing them by 25%. Uranus also generates a 300/390/480/570/660/750 (+200% Total Magic Power) shield for 4s.

The shield explodes at the end of its duration or when destroyed, dealing 300/390/480/570/660/750 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies nearby.

abilities.name: Consecration
abilities.description:
Uranus unleashes the energy stored within his body, removing slow effects on himself, recovering 200/300/400 HP, and gaining 60% Movement Speed for 8s (decays over time).

Uranus directly gains 5/10/15 stacks of Radiance, increasing shields received and HP Regen by 20% for 8s.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS

combos.name: LANING COMBOS

relationships.title: assist

relationships.title: strong

relationships.title: weak
