name: Kimmy
title: Hoverjet Outrider
story:
If you were to ask Kimmy about her most vivid childhood memory, she would tell you without hesitation - it was the weight of the medals adorning her father's military uniform. Born into a military family, the young girl secretly vowed to become an even greater soldier than her father.

But when she enthusiastically shared her dream with him, his usual gentle demeanor turned stern as he rejected her aspirations. Putting his calloused hand over her little head, he said, "I want my daughter to have a peaceful, carefree life."

Though her wings were confined within the cage her father built, Kimmy never abandoned her dreams of soaring. She read military books in secret, looked through her family's military records, and even after being sent to Eruditio for schooling, she never stopped dreaming.

Perhaps Kimmy's most carefree and joyful days were spent in Eruditio. She cut her hair short and made many friends, and one in particular, Beatrix, became her closest companion. The two were drawn together by the fierce determination they shared. Kimmy helped Beatrix test various weapons - no matter how complex their design or intricate their controls, she always seemed to bring out their true potential.

"Why not just go for it? Enlist first and tell him later!" Kimmy's heart raced at Beatrix's suggestion. As their fists bumped together, their rebellious alliance was officially sealed.

Kimmy packed up and left Eruditio to join the Moniyan Empire's Western Border Guard. The closer she got to the military outpost, the more desolate the surroundings became, but her heart had never felt more fulfilled. She stretched her hand upward, as though she could grasp the sky itself.

Kimmy's early days in the Border Guard were anything but easy. Her time spent in Eruditio and her young age led many of the hardened soldiers to dismiss her as a privileged girl who was just looking for some cheap thrills. She paid their gossip no mind, instead throwing herself into her training, using her pent-up ambition as fuel for her fire, and the results showed; she came first in the Imperial Joint Tactical Exercise and demonstrated extraordinary talent in both marksmanship and close- quarters combat. Her achievements finally silenced the rumors and naysayers. Many began to see Kimmy in a new light, and some were even inspired to train harder.

It was then that the Weapons Department invented a new weapon - a Starlium- powered jetpack and rifle. However, its complex operation was too much for most of the testers, yet Kimmy's talent and experience allowed her to master it almost immediately. The weapon found its full potential in her hands, shocking even the researchers. The flashes of the muzzle illuminated Kimmy's path forward - the Hoverjet Blaster became her weapon, and together they would shine in battle.

Kimmy paid no mind to others' cold stares, focusing solely on her own efforts. The fledging had shed her down and was ready to spread her wings and soar. Yet... thoughts of her father still filled her with doubt.

Soon after, Kimmy was assigned to an elite squad, deploying her weapon into battle for the first time on an important rescue mission. The enemy, highly mobile and intimate with the terrain, had the upper hand. Though it was Kimmy's first real combat mission, she remained remarkably calm. She quickly identified the enemy's movement patterns, tracked them to a small outpost, and launched a successful first strike on her own.

Before the thrill of victory could fade, the full scope of the enemy's operations was revealed: they had kidnapped military researchers to force them to create new weapons. Worse still, they had already used stolen weapons to ambush the front- line troops, causing heavy casualties. With no time to call for backup, Kimmy disguised herself with the enemy's attire and infiltrated their stronghold, quickly locating the holding cells.

Behind iron bars were over a dozen imprisoned allies. Kimmy acted decisively, blasting open the prison doors with her rifle. The sound alerted her comrades waiting to launch their attack outside. With their coordinated assault from both inside and out, chaos erupted in the enemy stronghold, leading to their quick defeat.

As Kimmy evacuated the prisoners, an older officer, slowed due to his injuries, caught her attention. Those familiar shoulders, that crew cut of gray hair - it was her father. The usually fearless Kimmy felt her confidence waver. She had never told her strict father about enlisting. As their eyes met, Kimmy braced for the worst. However, after a moment's pause, he simply gave her a formal military salute pretending not to recognize his masked daughter. His voice was no longer as deep as she remembered, and his injured stature seemed smaller than she remembered. He advised the "new recruit" to make something of herself in the military. Kimmy shouldered her weapon and nodded solemnly while trying to keep her voice from trembling.

New missions awaited on the horizon. Kimmy looked to the sky, knowing that her wings now carried her father's expectations. She was bound for even greater heights.
brief: Born into a traditional military family in the Moniyan Empire, she received military education from an early age, so she was a little boyish. At the same time, Kimmy is not bound by tradition. She is obsessed with technology and inventions In order to prove herself to her father, Kimmy picks up her invention and joined the Imperial Expeditionary Army.
blurb: Born into a military family, she earned recognition through her own merit as the bold yet laid-back "tough girl" of the Border Guard.

abilities.name: Aerial Dominance
abilities.description:
Kimmy can move and aim in different directions when using her Spray Gun, but cannot lock on to a specific enemy. Kimmy's Spray Gun attack deals (+18% Total Physical Attack) (+24% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Hitting enemy heroes/non-hero units restores 6/3 Starlium respectively. At max Starlium, Kimmy continuously consumes Starlium to enhance her Basic Attacks, making them deal (+22.5% Total Physical Attack) (+30% Total Magic Power) damage and pierce through targets (enhanced Basic Attacks only benefit from 50% of Lifesteal Ratio).
Kimmy doesn't stop moving while shooting and no longer benefits from Attack Speed Bonus. Every 1% Attack Speed she gains is converted to 1 Magic Power.
Kimmy's Basic Attacks only deal 60% damage to Turrets.

abilities.name: Anti-Grav Thruster
abilities.description:
Kimmy uses her jetpack to take flight, removing and becoming immune to Slow Effects. She can pass through terrain and gains 120% Movement Speed that decays over 1s. During the flight, she fires 4 Chemical Bolts at nearby enemies, each dealing 20/25/30/35/40/45 (+25% Total Physical Attack) (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by 50% for 0.5s.
Kimmy does not consume Starlium during flight.

abilities.name: Starlium Beam
abilities.description:
Kimmy fires a Starlium Beam in the target direction that immobilizes enemies in its path and deals 300/360/420/480/540/600 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage for 1s.
Gain 20/24/28/32/36/40 Starlium for each enemy hero hit.

abilities.name: Traction Pulse
abilities.description:
Kimmy charges and fires a Traction Pulse in a target direction. Upon hitting an enemy or reaching its max range, it explodes to deal 150/225/300 (+45% Total Physical Attack) (+54% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and creates a force field that slows enemies within by 50%.
After 1s, the field contracts, pulling all enemy heroes to its center and dealing 15/22.5/30% of their current HP as Magic Damage while slowing them by 50% for 2s. Gain 40 Starlium for each enemy hero hit.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Kimmy can initiate with her Ultimate to group up enemies, then follow up with her 2nd Skill to immobilize them, and finish with her enhanced Basic Attacks for lots of damage. If enemies try to counter by closing in on Kimmy, use her 1st Skill to retreat.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Build up Starlium before engaging. Use her 1st Skill to quickly close in on the opponent, then use her 2nd Skill to immobilize them before unleashing her enhanced Basic Attacks for great damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Kimmy excels at controlling and grouping enemies while dealing substantial damage, so she works well with heroes who have AOE CC like Badang and Ruby.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Kimmy's ability to Basic Attack while moving makes her effective against heroes who rely on skillshots like Granger and Cecilion.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: As a Marksman who cannot lock onto targets with Basic Attacks, Kimmy can be countered by heroes with high burst damage and mobility, such as Saber and Lancelot.

name: Thamuz
title: Lord Lava
story:
In the deepest depths of the Abyss, molten magma churns at the birthplace of the formidable Fire Demons. Among them was Thamuz, who rose to become the mightiest Fire Demon and their leader. With his overwhelming strength and blazing temper, he controls the depths of the Abyss with an iron fist. Now, as the corruption seeping through the Abyss threatens to wipe out his race, Thamuz seeks to ascend to godhood and crush fate with his own hands. To this end, he and his Fire Demons will burn everything to ash, until nothing is left!

"You must never allow the Heart of Lava to become cold and harden."

Thamuz still remembered the words of the former Lord of Lava. Thamuz was just a general back then-when the Sovereign of the Abyss ordered them to go to war, he forged his scythes from obsidian and lava, and reaped the battlefield with his blazing flames.

However, the former lord saw in him not just strength that surpassed all others, but also wisdom rare among their kind. After the sovereign issued another call to arms, the former lord summoned Thamuz once more to the birthplace of the Fire Demons.

This time, however, it wasn't to send him off to battle-it was to keep him from it.

The Heart of Lava is the essence of the Fire Demons. As the wars raged on, more and more Fire Demons perished on the battlefield, littering them with grim statues. And with each loss, the Heart of Lava grew colder, spelling the downfall of the Fire Demons.

The call of war could not be refused, but the Fire Demons desperately needed a new future-one that only the new generation like Thamuz could forge.

After his succession, Thamuz began the revival of the Fire Demons. During the brief respites from the fighting, the Fire Demons would see a resurgence in influence.

But Thamuz was not fooled by these illusions. Looking at the races of the Abyss and the above races driven by the God of Light, he saw how race after race had disappeared from history in the Endless War. The obsidian and granite structures his ancestors once erected as the builders of the Abyss civilization now lay in ruins. The so-called gods sought only victory, treating all life as mere pawns in their petty game.

The suffering of the Abyss must end.

With this conviction, Thamuz led the Fire Demons to join the rebels, and in the final battle, commanded his forces deep into the Night Palace in the lowest depths of the Abyss. As he confronted the creator of the Abyss civilization, the power stirring in his blood confirmed the sovereign's words about the Abyss's nurturing nature.

But the power that once nourished the Abyss like a sun had become its enemy, discarding the lives of its subjects at will-and for that, she had to perish! nothing

After an earth-shattering battle, Thamuz ended the sovereign's life with his own hands, while the rebels succeeded in their plan to defeat both the God of Light and God of Darkness.

Standing upon the ravaged pits of the Abyss, Thamuz resolved to forge a new Abyss, one that could stand equal to the surface world. Using the sovereign's blood as fuel, Thamuz brought the Abyss into a new era.

But fate is a cruel mistress. The sovereign's blood curse began to spread through the Abyss, corrupting the very essence of many Abyssal beings, driving their minds mad and twisting their bodies. Even the Heart of Lava, nourished by the sovereign's blood, was not spared. Watching his brethren fall to madness one by one, Thamuz's ideals crumbled.

Amidst this chaos, Thamuz also had to fight against the mad Abyssal beings who sought to claim the sovereign's remains slumbering within the Night Palace-should they succeed, the outcome would make the current dark corruption seem gentle in comparison.

The endless battles and fruitless labor let pain and rage devour Thamuz's heart. He gradually realized that only overwhelming power could subdue these lesser beings, and only transcendent power could overcome the curse.

He must become a god, and then surpass even godhood.

This shift disappointed many of his former allies and even made them fearful of Thamuz. But against the unstoppable dark corruption, their counsel rang hollow. Someone had to shoulder the fate of the Abyss, and Thamuz was convinced it had to be him.

Thousands of years passed, and as madness and mutation grew ever worse, the Abyss became unrecognizable. The Lord of Lava, constantly reforging himself in the flames of war, continued his conquest and ascension toward godhood.

His pride would not allow him to forget that promise.

I will become the new sun of the Abyss, and my blood will ensure that the lava burns eternal!
brief: In the deepest depths of the Abyss, molten magma churns at the birthplace of the formidable Fire Demons. Among them was Thamuz, who rose to become the mightiest Fire Demon and their leader. With his overwhelming strength and blazing temper, he controls the depths of the Abyss with an iron fist. Now, as the corruption seeping through the Abyss threatens to wipe out his race, Thamuz seeks to ascend to godhood and crush fate with his own hands. To this end, he and his Fire Demons will burn everything to ash, until nothing is left!
blurb: The lord of the Fire Demons who seeks to reignite the flames of the Abyss through war and violence.

abilities.name: Grand Lord Lava
abilities.description:
Thamuz's Basic Attacks have a 10%–60% chance (based on Lava's Rage) to conjure Lava Energy beneath the target that erupts after a brief delay, dealing 55 (+60% Total Physical Attack)(+8*Hero Level) True Damage. Basic Attacks that don't trigger Lava Energy will increase Thamuz's Lava's Rage.
When without Scythes, Thamuz gains 25% Movement Speed. After retrieving his Scythes, his next Basic Attack slows the target by 30% and is guaranteed to trigger Lava Energy.

abilities.name: Molten Scythes
abilities.description:
Thamuz tosses Scythes in the target direction. After travelling for a certain distance or hitting the first enemy hero, they deal 120/150/180/210/240/270 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. The Scythes will then slow nearby enemies by 30% and deal 45/52/59/66/73/80 (+20% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage every 0.5s.
After leaving Thamuz for a period of time or a certain distance, the Scythes will return to Thamuz and drag enemies in their path to him. Thamuz can approach the Scythes or cast the skill again to retrieve them.

abilities.name: Chasm Trample
abilities.description:
Thamuz jumps to a designated area to deal 230/255/280/305/330/355 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slow the enemy units by 25% for 2s upon landing.
If the Scythes are still travelling, they will return to Thamuz and Molten Scythes will reset its CD instantly.

abilities.name: Cauterant Inferno
abilities.description:
Thamuz spouts the lava stored in his body, dealing 300/390/480 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and creating a Cauterant Inferno around him. The Cauterant Inferno lasts 9s and deals 30/45/60 (+10% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage every 0.5s to enemies in the area.
Meanwhile, Thamuz gains 800/1000/1200 (+50% Extra Max HP) extra Max HP, heals himself by the same amount, and increases his Attack Speed by 60/80/100%. He also recovers 1.5% Max HP each time he deals damage with Basic Attacks or his Scythes.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Thamuz's 1st Skill to speed up and adjust positioning, then jump into the crowd using his 2nd Skill. Activate his Ultimate followed by a Basic Attack and his 1st Skill, and retrieve the Scythes before continuing with Basic Attacks.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Thamuz's 1st Skill, then leap to enemy using his 2nd Skill, causing his Scythes to return and resetting the CD of his 1st Skill. Follow up with a Basic Attack and then his 1st Skill, and tap the skill again to retrieve the Scythes and end with Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Thamuz can play to his strength when working with Supports who provide Movement Speed or CC, such as Angela and Rafaela, because they enable him to stay on his targets.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Thamuz is good against other sustained damage Fighters like Zilong and Sun because he has the top notch laning power.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Thamuz is countered by agile Marksmen, such as Karrie and Irithel, since he lacks CC and relies on Basic Attacks, making him an easy target to kite.

name: Harith
title: Time Traveler
story:
Legends say that an ancient race of elves reside in the Land of Dawn's Enchanted Forest. The stories often depict this cat-like race as small in stature, agile, playful, independent, and highly intelligent. However, few are aware of the longstanding alliance between the Leonin Elves and the Moon Elves.

From a young age, Harith surpassed his peers in talent and wisdom. He quickly became the strongest mage among the Leonins, perhaps as strong as other in the Land of Dawn. Although, the Leonins never step foot outside of the Enchanted Forest, living a peaceful and safe life on their own. The Leonins became so complacent with their blissful existence that they no longer pursed the magic arts, a hallmark of their people. Harith became very discontent with this trend and confidently set out of the Enchanted Forest to see the outside world at the young age of 15. Harith was driven by his and passion for the magic arts, aspiring to become his people's leader in magic.

Harith arrived at the Moniyan Empire, where he joined armies to fight off the invading orc tribes. Proving himself in battle, Harith gained the recognition of Tigreal, who came to appreciate Harith's lovely spirit and strong abilities. People say, Harith was given the rank of lieutenant and will soon be appointed as an Imperial Master of Magic of the Moniyan Empire. With that said, Harith has imperial authorization to use magic to control space and time to unlock the Secrets of Dawn to seal away evil and protect justice.

Full of excitement and fervor, Harith also knew that once he is appointed the title of Master of Magic that he will become a target of public criticism. Committed to his dream of becoming his people's leader in magic, Harith fearlessly marched forward alone. Over time, Harith discovered that his life was consumed by his mission and by the empire. Harith slowly grew lonely and reclusive. Even when he met his fellow Leonin, Nana, he was unable to maintain a normal conversation. Despite Nana showing signs of affection towards him, he could not express his feelings, believing that the best way to protect her from criticism was for him be alone. After all, whenever the empire needed magical assistance, the Master of Magic was on the job to seal away the dangers of evil.
brief: Legends say that an ancient race of elves reside in the Land of Dawn's Enchanted Forest. The stories often depict this cat-like race as small in stature, agile, playful, independent, and highly intelligent. However, few are aware of the longstanding alliance between the Leonin Elves and the Moon Elves.
blurb: Leonin boy who came to the Moniyan Empire from Azrya.

abilities.name: Key Insight
abilities.description: Harith gains insight from his Key. He gains 7% Hybrid Lifesteal for each nearby enemy hero, stacking up to 35%.

abilities.name: Synchro Fission
abilities.description:
Harith creates a phantom of himself in a distant location. Harith and his phantom will then release Synchro Fission toward each other, dealing 150/180/210/240/270/300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemy units on the path.

When the 2 energy waves collide, an explosion occurs, dealing 450/540/630/720/810/900 (+180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in the area.
This skill deals 60% extra damage to creeps (up to 1500 damage).

abilities.name: Chrono Dash
abilities.description:
Harith dashes towards the target direction, gaining a 120/150/180/210/240/270 (+120% Total Magic Power) shield and enhancing his next Basic Attack. Harith's enhanced Basic Attack deals 200/230/260/290/320/350 (+100% Total Physical Attack)(+70% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slows enemies by 40%. Hitting an enemy with Harith's enhanced Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of Chrono Dash by 3s. This shield can stack up to 3 times.

The enhanced Basic Attack deals 50/60/70/80/90/100 (+100% Total Physical Attack)(+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to Turrets.

abilities.name: Zaman Force
abilities.description:
Harith uses his Key to summon the Zaman Force, creating a multidimensional rift. Upon appearance, it reduces the cooldown of Chrono Dash by 4s. The rift continuously slows enemy heroes in the area by 40%.

When Harith comes into contact with the rift using Chrono Dash, he absorbs its energy, reducing the cooldown of Synchro Fission by 1s and Chrono Dash by 3s. Harith gains 15% Resilience while on the rift.
abilities.flavor_text: "They say geniuses recognize one another!", a quote from Harley.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, first use Harith's 2nd Skill to get close to the enemy, then follow up with the Ultimate, and start spamming his 1st and 2nd Skill. Dashing through the Ultimate not only reduces his skill cooldowns, but also allows Harith to get multiple enhanced Basic Attacks from his 2nd Skill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, approach the enemy with Harith's 2nd Skill, hit them with an enhanced Basic Attack, then use his 1st Skill to chip away their HP.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Harith pairs well with heroes who have AOE CC and can make it harder for enemies to escape his Ultimate's range, such as Minsitthar and Minotaur.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Harith is a very agile hero and his Ultimate reduces the duration of control effects, so he is excellent at countering heroes who rely on CC and have relatively long casting animations, like Belerick and Johnson.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Harith is countered by heroes who can quickly escape from his Ultimate, such as Novaria and Pharsa.

name: Minsitthar
title: Courageous Warrior
story:
I stood under the towering castle wall, it was just another day in my commonplace life as a noteless maid.
A sudden baby cry shook the sun but the birth of a prince could not awaken my stranding life.
I stood under the towering castle wall, praises and blessings came to my ears: Some wished him to be benevolent; some wished him to be brave; some wished him to have a great future...
I have seen so many royals and nobles in my life, their authorities are like knives at my throat.
Just like this moment, I am waiting for my masters to punish me as my senility made me break the dishes.
A little figure stands in front of me with a short wooden sword — the praised prince is protecting me just like he swore to protect his subjects.
Now I wish so much he could grow up safely and bring warmth to people like the sun over Mahar Pura.

Kneeling on the cracked farmland, I prayed for the rain to save our dying crops, parched mouth, and despairing hearts.
But what came before the rain was our savior in golden armor, he brought us food and relieved our suffering.
When he looked down at his subjects, I could see a whole world in the depth of his eyes, a world that was as beautiful as a landscape.
When he raised his eyes, he noticed the figure of a little rosewood flower, which made the world in his eyes jump with joy.
Later, I was told that our savior, the crown prince of our kingdom, fell in love with a civilian girl.
He shook off his royal trifles and chased free life with the girl. However, free life is not all about the starry sky and love.
It also means paddy, sack clothes, and hard work within fields.
This time, the prince finally got the chance to see the truth of the world and the lives of his fellow subjects.

I marched to the battlefield with my comrades as the enemy warships once again broke through our naval defenses.
The black waves flooded from the horizon toward us and soon turned into millions of blades.
My comrades, my brothers, were pierced by the blades. They told me to bring their last smile back to our hometown.
The black clouds poured out from enemy ships, covering the sun. We fought for our lives desperately but no hope could be seen.
Suddenly, a golden light split across the gloomy sky, driving away all the darkness on the battlefield.
I recognized the Sacred Spear in the comer's hand. That was our crown prince! The sun of Mahar Pura!
He blocked all the enemy attacks with his tough body.
He blew the horn to rally the desperate soldiers.
Torches gathered from all over the battlefield and formed a wildfire.
Under his leadership, we wrapped up all the darkness and pushed them back to where they came from.
Later, we knelt before our new king and swore to be his feet and spear. May Mahar Pura shine forever.

I met him again at a very old age. He returned to the palace and basked in the radiance of the crown again.
I was told he once put aside his duties and lived a farmer's life with his true love. However, he couldn't turn a blind eye to the bitterness of his people.
He left his rosewood flower garden, reforged his Sacred Spear, and went back to the brutal battlefield.
Now I live behind the castle walls, free from the sound of battle horns. Thanks to warriors like him, I can still pour wine with care and respect.
I offer him the cup of wine, he looks down, there's loneliness in his eyes.
But the bright sun still shines upon the unvarying land of Mahar Pura as always.
brief: A prince of the Vonetis Sea's Mahar Pura, good at fighting and winning. He was expelled by his father because of a heretical love affair he had. When his brother raised the flag of rebellion, Minsitthar, who was in exile, returned to his motherland, put down the rebellion and became the new king.
blurb: A young king that led the people of Mahar Pura to victory against invaders.

abilities.name: Mark of the King
abilities.description: Minsitthar's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of <highlight>Mark of the King</highlight>, up to 5 stacks. Upon reaching max stacks, the next attack detonates all <highlight>Mark of the King</highlight> stacks, dealing <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> equal to 400<scaleHP> (+6% Total HP)</scaleHP> of Minsitthar's Max HP and stunning the target for 0.8s while healing Minsitthar for 400<scaleHP> (+6% Total HP)</scaleHP> HP. Can only trigger once every 6s on the same target.

abilities.name: Spear of Glory
abilities.description: Minsitthar thrusts forward with the Spear of Glory, dealing 175/200/225/250/275/300<scaleAD> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and slowing enemies hit by 30%. Enemy heroes hit by the tip of the spear will be stunned for 0.6s. After a short delay, Minsitthar pulls back the spear, dealing 175<scaleAD> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to all enemies along the way and dragging enemy heroes hit to him.

abilities.name: Shield Assault
abilities.description: Minsitthar awakens the power in his shield and releases it, dealing 100/120/140/160/180/200<scaleAD> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to all enemies in a rectangular area and slowing them by 80% (decaying rapidly over 2s). Meanwhile, he enters <highlight>Phalanx</highlight> state for 3s, reducing damage taken from the front by 25/30/35/40/45/50% and enhancing his Basic Attack to swiftly strike an area in front of him for 100/120/140/160/180/200<scaleAD> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> per hit.

abilities.name: King's Calling
abilities.description:
Minsitthar charges forward and calls 4 Royal Guards to form a field around him. The Royal Guards cannot move but will attack enemies in the field and deal (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to them.
Enemies in the field are slowed by 20% and cannot use movement skills.
abilities.flavor_text: Where will I be?

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Minsitthar should use his 1st Skill to pull in multiple enemies before using his Ultimate to restrict their movement, and then use his 2nd Skill's enhanced Basic Attacks to deal AOE damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Minsitthar should use his 1st Skill to pull the enemy to him and slow them with his 2nd Skill, before unleashing his enhanced Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Minsitthar works best with high damage Marksmen, such as Melissa and Hanabi, because he can create more opportunities for them to deal damage.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Minsitthar is strong against heroes that rely on mobility skills since his Ultimate disables them. Minsitthar can instantly negate the advantages of heroes like Lancelot, Benedetta and Arlott.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Minsitthar is countered by heroes with high Movement Speed, such as Zilong and Aulus, who can easily dodge his 1st Skill and run out of his Ultimate.

name: Kadita
title: Ocean Goddess
story:
The Queen of the Southern Seas, Kadita, was once the princess of a small island nation. Admired by everyone, Kadita was considered by all to be genuine, intelligent, and kind-hearted. However, fate oftentimes finds its way to hit people with strife. Kadita was no different. As the heir apparent to the king, a member within the royal family grew jealous of Kadita and conspired to ruin her — An unknown mage wielding the power of black magic viciously attacked the princess. Kadita came under a powerful spell that robbed her of all her beauty, giving her a strange skin disease in the process.

The people of the kingdom tried everything they could think of to help their beloved princess, but no one could break the spell. Overtime, people's love for Kadita faded, causing her to lose power and confidence. Out of tremendous despair, Kadita threw herself into the stormy Southern Seas. However, Kadita was rescued by the ocean demons. Using the trident of the seas, the ocean demons were able to break Kadita's powerful spell, but due to her skin disease her skin was never able to return to its original complexion. On that day, Kadita become the legendary Queen of the Southern Seas.

Assuming all new powers, Kadita became adept at controlling the ocean waters and the weather. Sailors from all corners of the world came to fear the Southern Seas as they were bound to suffer the wrath of Kadita — No one dared to conquer the Southern Seas any longer. Survivors recant their experiences facing Kadita. Some way she had the appearance of a strange mermaid, while others said she was more beautiful than the princess they knew before. As stories of Kadita began to spread, legends say that she possessed seven legendary spears, each with its own unique abilities, used to punish any invaders who intended to violate the Southern Seas.

As the story goes, Kadita collected the seven spears while guarding the Southern Seas. No one has the power to use all seven spears at once, except for Kadita.
brief: A princess of a certain island country in the Vonetis Islands. She was victimized by poltical enemies and lost her beauty and power. When she threw herself into the sea in despair, an Elf in the sea rescued her. After that, she regained her beauty and turned into the form of a mermaid. With the help of the Elves, she became the Queen of the Southern Seas who all sailors fear.
blurb: Beautiful and powerful mermaid queen.

abilities.name: Thalassophobia
abilities.description: Kadita gains the <highlight>Blessing of the Ocean</highlight> every 30s. The Blessing is triggered when she takes damage from enemy heroes and lasts 4s, allowing her to recover 65% of the HP lost within the duration afterward.

abilities.name: Ocean Ode
abilities.description:
Kadita summons an ocean wave to carry herself in the target direction and back, dealing 250/290/330/370/410/450 (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. While inside the wave, she gains Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction. This skill can pass through obstacles and terrain.

Use Again: Kadita exits the wave without interrupting the wave's movement.

abilities.name: Breath of the Ocean
abilities.description:
After a short delay, Kadita summons an ocean wave to erupt at the target location, dealing 350/380/410/440/470/500 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 1s.

Kadita can cast this skill during Ocean Ode to summon an ocean wave beneath her with a shorter eruption delay.

abilities.name: Rough Waves
abilities.description:
Kadita dives into the ground and sends ocean waves in all directions (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), each dealing 270/300/330 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. Enemies hit by multiple waves take increased damage. After a short period, the waves return to Kadita, each dealing 180/200/220 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit.

When underground, Kadita becomes untargetable and gains 60% Movement Speed.
abilities.flavor_text: Seas and oceans take orders from me!

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, target the enemy's backline with Kadita's 1st Skill, and use her 2nd Skill when passing through enemies to knock them airborne. Follow up with her Ultimate for massive damage and avoid all incoming damage while being untargetable.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Kadita's 1st Skill to constantly harass enemies, and look for opportunities to use her 2nd Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Kadita works well with heroes who possess strong CC abilities, such as Atlas and Tigreal, as their CC will make it easier for Kadita to hit more enemies with her Ultimate.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Kadita excels at countering heroes that lack mobility, such as Aurora and Eudora, because it's difficult for them to escape Kadita's 2nd Skill, and knocking them airborne sets them up for her Ultimate.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Kadita is countered by heroes with long range and high mobility, such as Clint and Beatrix, since it's difficult for Kadita to close in on them or hit them with her 2nd Skill.

name: Faramis
title: Soul Binder
story:
Faramis came from a long line of physicians. With the ancestral staff passed down the family, his grandfather combined magic and medicine and developed cures for many once-incurable diseases. The feat earned the gifted physician a title from the Moniyan Empire, and the family had since served the royalties as their personal physicians.

None of these proved adequate to earn the family respect from their equals, though. The other nobles viewed them as mere servants with some special medical skills, while young Faramis, for this reason, was often bullied and ridiculed by his peers.

At a banquet, the boys struck again, and poor Faramis was left fainted on the ground of the back garden. When he regained consciousness, he saw a highborn girl half-knelt by his side, giving him medicine. That was the only time young Faramis had received kindness from his peers. The encounter, despite being brief, was like a ray of sunshine into his gloomy life.

Frail and sickly from birth, Faramis had brushed with death numerous times and survived only because of his parents' meticulous treatment. After many near-death experiences, he vowed to conquer death and take life into his own hands and was reluctant to serve the royalties as his family did.

He found the royalties' minor ailments extremely boring and wanted nothing to do with those hypocritical nobles. He yearned to challenge complex, intractable diseases to bring his skills to heights no other physicians had ever reached before.

With this goal in mind, Faramis left Lumina City and embarked on his journey alone, solving one after another inexplicable disease along the way, not out of the responsibility of a physician, but to explore the possibility of going beyond life and death.

Upon learning about the incident in Necrokeep, Faramis believed that he'd found the perfect integration of life and death and headed to the city right away, searching for the key to controlling both.

Protected by his ancestral staff, Faramis found himself immune to the Mist that plagued the city. He walked through crowds of desolate residents and came upon Duchess Vexana, ruler of the ruined fortress. She was brewing and handing out the "Moonlight Brew", a remedy made of Moonlight Grass that was said to be the "cure" for the erosion of the Mist.

At first, Faramis thought that was all a blunt lieâ€”she was only putting on an act, ignorant and hypocritical as the other nobles.

Until that one time, Vexana thrust the last "Moonlight Brew" in his hands without a second thought — Faramis was stunned. It was equal to giving up the "hope of life" to him.

The "hypocrite" really wanted to save everyone.

Looking at the noble lady in a new light, Faramis couldn't help but think of his brief encounter with the kindly girl in his childhood...

The Mist was nothing like the incurable diseases Faramis had encountered before. After many failed attempts, he finally made a breakthrough by infusing magic into the herbs. And with every progress he made, he insisted on testing the effects on himself. Except, his frail body could only take so much abuse. He soon started feeling the aftermath of his experiments, eventually falling faint in his laboratory.

Lying on the cold floor, Faramis felt his life quickly draining out of him. He clenched his fists and tried to get up, only to find he couldn't even peel open his eyes, his consciousness gradually fading.

...

Faramis never thought he could open his eyes again, and when he did, he saw a young lady leaning over, parting his lips to drop a bitter liquid into his mouth. With his mind in a haze, Faramis found the sight overlapped with his memory of the girl in the garden. Looking at the strange but familiar face, Faramis recognized that she was the very same noble girl who'd helped him back then.

The girl who'd brought light to his childhood had come to his aid again! During his recovery, Faramis found himself smitten with the young lady who'd saved him from darkness twice. She was the only person who'd never given him up except for his parents.

As soon as Faramis recovered, however, Vexana urged him to leave the place, saying it was dangerous for a living person to continue to stay in Necrokeep. The Mist was starting to overpower his enchanted staff. If he stayed any longer, he would soon meet a fate like theirs.

Faramis said not a word; his eyes fixated on the Moonlight Grass and the fading staff in his hands. His reason told him it was time to leave, but when he stood in front of the castle's gate and saw the forced smile on Vexana's face, he found himself unable to leave like this. Memories of the childhood encounter and the meticulous care in Necrokeep flashed across Faramis's mind. He could not give up the young lady who'd brought light and warmth twice to his life. He had made his choice, he would stay in Necrokeep and finish the task yet to be done.

Faramis let go of the protection of his staff, finally basking in the blight of the Mist. His skin turned sallow and pale, and yet he felt no fear. He knew he could conquer this scourge. And to do so, to uncover the secrets of life and death, he must experience the curse for himself.

This time, it was his turn to pull Vexana out of the misery she was in.
brief: A gifted physician who came to Necrokeep to study the mysterious plague. Instead of finding the key to controlling life and death, he met Vexana, duchess of the cursed land and the girl who'd brought sunshine to his gloomy life twice. Vowing to find a way to revert the curse and repay the kindness of Vexana, Faramis voluntarily got eroded by the Mist and used himself as the specimen for his research.
blurb: A necromancer in Necrokeep who's determined to find a cure for the Mist.

abilities.name: Vicious Retrieval
abilities.description: Every 4s, Faramis' next skill against enemy heroes and summoned objects generates a soul fragment on the spot. Faramis can absorb the soul fragment to restore 100<scaleAP> (+50% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> HP and gain 2 extra Magic Power (up to 40 stacks). Upon death, he consumes the absorbed soul fragments to reduce the respawn timer, each reducing the timer by 3% (up to 90%). Enemies that die around Faramis also have a chance to drop soul fragments.

abilities.name: Shadow Stampede
abilities.description:
Faramis enters the Shadow state for 3s, gaining 70% extra Movement Speed, 25/30/35/40/45/50 extra Physical & Magic Defense, 20% cooldown reduction of this skill, and the ability to move through terrain. Enemy heroes that come into contact with Faramis in this state are dealt 250/280/310/340/370/400 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applied with a Nether Mark. Upon leaving the Shadow state, Faramis drags all the marked enemy heroes toward him, dealing 250/280/310/340/370/400 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Use again to leave the Shadow state early and drag marked enemies toward him.
The range of soul fragment absorption is increased while this skill is active.

abilities.name: Ghost Bursters
abilities.description: Faramis gathers Nether energy in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing 330/360/390/420/450/480<scaleAP> (+144% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies within. The energy will then split and bounce to nearby enemies, dealing 200/220/240/260/280/300<scaleAP> (+86% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> (splits up to 2 time(s) on enemy hero hits and 1 time(s) on non-enemy hero hits).

abilities.name: Nether Realm
abilities.description: Faramis turns his surroundings into the <highlight>Nether Realm</highlight> for 6s, making affected allied heroes (including himself) enter the <highlight>Specter</highlight> state and granting them 400/600/800 plus 10<scaleAP> (+5% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP>% extra HP and 50% extra Movement Speed for 1s. When the <highlight>Specter</highlight> state breaks, the hero will clear all debuffs and enter a brief Resurrection state for 1.3s. An allied hero's <highlight>Specter</highlight> state ends when they leave the <highlight>Nether Realm</highlight>.
abilities.flavor_text: Pain, destruction, death, rebirth! Enjoy the process!

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Faramis' Ultimate to protect his allies, then get close to the enemy and apply Nether Marks with his 1st Skill. Activate the 1st Skill again to pull them over and follow up with his 2nd Skill for additional damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Faramis' 1st Skill to get close to the enemy and hit them with his 2nd Skill while applying a Nether Mark with the 1st Skill. Then, use his 1st Skill again to pull the enemy back to him.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Faramis works well with heroes that are designed to dive into the enemy, such as Leomord and Martis, as he'll be able to maximize the life-saving effect of his Ultimate.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Faramis' ability to temporarily prevent teammates from being killed makes him a good pick against heroes that go all-in to burst down a target, like Saber and Eudora.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Faramis is countered by high mobility heroes that are difficult for him to catch with his 1st Skill, such as Novaria and Pharsa.

name: Badang
title: Tribal Warrior
story:
Long ago there was a small village resting in the southern regions of the Land of Dawn. The villagers were very hardworking, fishing day and night for a living. Among them was a strong man, named Badang. Enthusiastic and brave, he tirelessly helped everyone solve their difficulties in life.

However, a strange thing happened in the village not long ago. The villagers got up early every day to catch fish. In the evening, they returned empty-handed, even the tools for fishing were broken. Everyone was upset, thinking it was the curse of a mystical water monster. As food supplies ran low, Badang decided to give them a hand to find out the truth. He did not believe in the water monster.

In the early morning, Badang went out to fish as usual. He came to the river near the village to set up a fishing trap. He not only placed a lot of fish, but also hid it with a giant fishing net prepared in advance, trying to find out who or what was causing the village's problems. Shortly after, the river suddenly began to bubble, and a strange creature in the river appeared next to his trap. Devil-like and fearsome, it began to steal the fish and destroy the trap. Its eyes were fiery, with long hair and a long beard. Badang decisively threw a giant fishing net, trying to trap the monster. However, the monster pierced the fishing net with its giant teeth and started to break free. It constantly attacked him, but the fearless Badang jumped into battle with this fearsome beast without hesitation. The power of this monster was surprisingly strong and Badang's arms were severely injured. When the beast was about to devour Badang, he used his remaining strength to insert the fishing spear into its body, and then pulled it to the river shore. After leaving the river, the monster gradually lost its moisture and began to dry. It couldn't breathe for long. Badang had never seen such a creature.

Badang noticed a magical gem sparkling in its body. Struggling to speak, the water monster begged Badang to let it go, swearing it was the elf who lived in the river but suffered a horrible transformation. Once the beast headed to the southern mountains to prey on the fish but accidentally ate fish corrupted by evil energy. As it spoke, the beast's body gradually began to change. The water beast began to regurgitate all the fish it consumed, along with the evil energy. Having returned to its natural state, the water elf deeply appreciated Badang.

After that, Badang got a stream of powerful energy and his injured arms were also restored and were way more powerful than before. Badang's kind heart drove him to finally let go of the monster. Badang started helping the villagers day and night, whose lives slowly returned to normal. However, Badang couldn't let go of the southern mountains that the monster spoke of. For the safety of his village, Badang was determined to find the source of the evil energy within the mountains and traveled across the islands, towards the Land of Dawn.
brief: Born in the Vonetis Islands off the southern part of the mainland. Originally just an ordinary villager, after defeating the water monster that was harassing the village, he gained huge power from the water monster. After that, Badang set out to the mountains of the southern Moniyan Empire where the Abyss was entrenched, hoping to completely solve the problem of the water source being contaminated by the Abyss.
blurb: Island hero who gained supernatural power after defeating the water monster.

abilities.name: Chivalry Fist
abilities.description:
Every time Badang's Basic Attack hits a target, he gains a stack of Chivalry Fist. After gaining 4 stacks, his next Basic Attack deals 50 (+30% Total Physical Attack) extra Physical Damage to enemies hit and knocks them back. Enemies that are knocked into obstacles will be stunned for 0.6s (Minions and Creeps are stunned directly).
Fist Wind generated by Badang's skills will trigger this effect directly, and Fist Wind from his Ultimate increases the stun duration to 1s.

abilities.name: Fist Wind
abilities.description:
Badang unleashes a gust of Fist Wind in the target direction, dealing 125/145/175/185/205/225 (+90% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit, slowing them by 30% for 1.5s, and knocking them back. The Fist Wind will explode upon hitting an obstacle, dealing 100/115/130/145/160/175 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies. Fist Wind can trigger attack effects and grants Badang 1 Chivalry Fist stack upon cast.
Badang stores up to 2 Fist Wind charges and restores 1 charge every 10.4/9.8/9.2/8.6/8/7.2s.

abilities.name: Fist Break
abilities.description:
Badang dashes in the target direction, dealing 230/250/270/290/310/330 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path while gaining a 350/420/490/560/630/700 (+150% Total Physical Attack) shield that lasts 5s. He stops immediately upon hitting an enemy hero, slightly knocking them back while creating an obstacle that lasts 4s behind them. Enemies hit by the obstacle are dealt 130/140/150/160/170/180 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

Use Again: Badang removes the obstacle he created.

abilities.name: Fist Crack
abilities.description:
Badang throws a flurry of punches in the target direction, dealing 60/90/120 (+54% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit multiple times (can trigger attack effects). The Fist Wind generated by the punches will explode upon hitting an obstacle, dealing 30/45/60 (+27% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies.
Badang is immune to control effects for the duration.
abilities.flavor_text: Fight to protect and persist for benevolence.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Badang's 2nd Skill when the enemy is grouped up to trap multiple targets in the barrier, and unleash his Ultimate to repeatedly knock them into it for massive damage. Then use his 1st Skill and Basic Attacks to continue the onslaught.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Badang's 1st Skill to whittle down the enemy's HP. Use his 2nd Skill to trap the enemy, then use his 1st Skill to knock them into the barrier to stun them, and finish with Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Badang works best with heroes that can pull enemies together to make it easier for him to land his 2nd Skill and Ultimate combo, such as Tigreal and Luo Yi.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Badang counters squishy heroes with low mobility like Layla and Odette who have a hard time escaping from his 2nd Skill into Ultimate combo.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Badang is countered by agile heroes such as Wanwan and Ling who can dodge or escape his 2nd Skill, greatly diminishing his damage and CC.

name: Khufra
title: Desert Tyrant
story:
In the far reaches of the Western Desert, an ancient city lays hidden among the sands. Despite ages passing by, the desert sands were unable to devour this city, which stands proud and majestic in a sea of emptiness. Scholars of antiquities have long spoke of this fabled city, whose most infamous ruler was none other than Khufra.

Khufra was a greedy ruler, colder than ice, and avaricious to limitless extents. In order to satisfy his personal desire to rule, he led the powerful army of Arnak to invade the city to conquer the Western Desert. Tirelessly, Khufra expanded his domain and riches beyond compare. Unfortunately, the Minoan Empire proved to be too difficult of a foe to conquer.

Even so, Khufra longed for more power. He sought the most famous astrologer in the Land of Dawn to help himself. Much to Khufra's dismay, the astrologer knew of Khufra's insidious goals and declined and was swiftly slain. Only the young Esmeralda felt deeply attracted to Khufra, who then became lovers. Khufra's callousness sent Esmeralda into a mess of internal conflict and love. Gradually, Esmeralda deeply loved Khufra and began to help Khufra with his rule. Over time, Esmeralda used her magical abilities to grant Khufra magical powers that were never before seen. However, Khufra became even more and more cruel and hungry for power. His conquests did not end with the Western Desert, he sought to conquer the entire Land of Dawn. Seeing the cruelty of her love, Esmeralda decided to save Khufra from the hate of the people.

Even then, Khufra continued to use magic to enhance his powers. He asked Esmeralda to give all the spells to him. He must completely eliminate the Minoan Empire. No one could question his power. One night, Esmeralda came to Khufra and she deeply embraced her lover. She began to place Khufra under a powerful curse, while Khufra was expecting the ultimate power given by Esmeralda. Suddenly, Khufra felt suppressed by a powerful force. He turned his head and looked at Esmeralda. No matter how Khufra tried to break free, Esmeralda did not stop chanting her curse. Khufra could not believe that his lover was punishing him. Esmeralda wept as she bound her love into an eternal slumber. She chose to personally seal her lover in the ancient city and built a grand monument. Esmeralda believed it was better to end Khufra before he became despised by the people, going down in history as the cruel king who loved nothing but power. Since then, the smoke of the war in the Western Desert disappeared.

However, hundreds of years later, a cataclysmic event occurred in the Western Desert. A wave of energy from an orb awakened Khufra from his slumber, who swelled with hatred and anger. Returning to the world. Khufra could not accept the betrayal of his lover in the past. His abilities and desires were stronger than ever before. He vowed to find Esmeralda and continue to conquer the centuries-old wish to hold the Land of Dawn within his hands.
brief: The ruler of the ancient city of Tivacan was furious, cold blooded and greedy. In order to obtain the help of the astrologers, the astrologer Esmeralda launched a crazy pursuit. Esmeralda was bewitched by him at first, but she awakened and sealed him up. Now he is about to wake up and continue to battle of destiny with the descendants of the astrologers.
blurb: Sealed ancient tyrant.

abilities.name: Spell Curse
abilities.description:
Khufra activates the Spell Curse left by Esmeralda every 8s, enhancing his next Basic Attack. The enhanced Basic Attack gains extra attack range and deals Magic Damage equal to 100 (+120% Total Physical Attack) plus 6% of the target's Max HP. He also slows the target by 30% for 1.5s and heals 8% of his Max HP on hit.
Each time Khufra applies a control effect to an enemy hero with his skill, the cooldown of Spell Curse is reduced by 4s.

abilities.name: Tyrant's Revenge
abilities.description: Khufra pulls the bandage on his arms to launch himself in the specified direction, dealing <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> equal to 50/60/70/80/90/100 plus 7<scaleAD> (+1.5% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD>% of his Max HP to all enemy units on the path. When blinking to the furthest distance or encountering a first enemy hero, Khufra will immediately stop, dealing <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> equal to 50/60/70/80/90/100 plus 7<scaleAD> (+1.5% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD>% of his Max HP to enemies nearby and then knocking them in the air for up to 1s.

abilities.name: Bouncing Ball
abilities.description:
Khufra uses bandage to wrap himself into a magic bouncing ball, increasing his own Physical & Magic Defense by 30/44/58/72/86/100%. Enemies trying to use blink skills to move across Khufra will be knocked airborne.
Each time the magic bouncing ball hits the ground, it will deal Magic Damage equal to 50/60/70/80/90/100 plus 3 (+2% Extra Physical Attack)% of his Max HP to enemies nearby and slow them by 80% for 0.2s.

abilities.name: Tyrant's Rage
abilities.description: Khufra pushes back all enemy targets around him toward his front (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 300/450/600<scaleAD> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and slowing them down for 1.25/1.5/1.75s. If the enemies are knocked against walls, extra <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> equal to 150% of this skill's damage will be inflicted upon them, and they will be stunned, instead of slowed.
abilities.flavor_text: Let those who comply with me thrive and those who resist me perish.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Khufra should open with his 1st Skill, then his Ultimate for area control, follow up with his 2nd Skill to prevent the enemy from escaping with their dash or blink skills.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Khufra uses his 1st Skill to aim while charging before launching himself to CC the enemy target. He then deals damage and slows the target with his enhanced Basic Attack and follows up with his 2nd Skill to keep the target slowed.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Khufra works best with heroes with strong CC abilities that make it easier for his 1st Skill to hit, such as Eudora and Pharsa.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Khufra's 2nd Skill can be used to interrupt movement abilities, making him strong against heroes who fight with movement abilities, such as Joy and Lancelot.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Khufra is countered by resilient tank heroes, as his CC abilities pose no threat to these heroes. Heroes like Fredrinn and Gloo are good examples here.

name: Granger
title: Death Chanter
story:
An unnamed town on the edge of the Moniyan Empire is Granger's destination for this journey

He walked quietly, the bright red scarf around his neck giving off an eerie aura. His skin was as pale as parchment, with a high collar covering half his face, revealing only a pair of somber eyes

Granger made his way to the outskirts of town, fully aware of what was waiting for him. Although their deep growls were hard to catch, the ringing in his ears that he despises was getting louder

Suddenly, a familiar melody caught Granger's attention. A child is sitting on the street, playing a tune on a flute. It's the "Hymn of Light," a song he often heard when he was young.

Granger's childhood was tragic, to say the least

One night, his town was attacked by demons. With no place to run, Granger's parents hid him in a small space under the floorboards. As the demons broke in and dragged his parents away, their cries and the demonic snarls left an indelible shadow in his young heart. That memory turned into a constant ringing in his ears, torturing Granger night after night. The pain caused him to distance himself from others and he became increasingly reclusive. Until the day a beautiful and gentle melody calmed the ringing, like a warm hand across his heart, granting him a moment of peace that he had almost forgotten.

For the first time, he stepped out of his chaotic world and looked up to see a priest playing the violin.

"What's the name of this piece?"

The priest took out a pen and paper from his pocket and wrote down the words "Hymn of Light."

It turned out that the priest was once the lead of the Monastery of Light's choir. It was his job to soothe the suffering hearts of the people with his voice. But years ago, when Alice infiltrated Lumina City and sent the city into chaos, the priest was struck by a demon and lost the ability to speak. But instead of wallowing in despair, he picked up the violin and continued to help others through music.

Perhaps the violin's sound was too inviting. Granger came out of his world and followed the priest to the monastery. He even tried learning the violin but could only produce discordant noises.

"Looks like I don't have any talent," a discouraged Granger lamented. The priest smiled and showed him that true melody doesn't come from talent, but from the kindness and perseverance in one's heart, and in this aspect, he believed Granger had plenty.

Granger, who failed to make much progress with music, showed exceptional talent in hunting demons. The church's leaders personally invited him to join the ranks of their demon hunters, even gifting him a specialized weapon—a pair of demon-devouring guns that could absorb demonic energy and convert it into special demon-slaying bullets. The few friends he had, including Alucard, invited him to hunt demons together, but Granger refused. Although the priest's music had healed his chaotic world, the night his parents died still remained in his heart like a permanent wound, bleeding at the slightest touch.

The priest respected Granger's decision. He believed that even the deepest wounds could heal one day, and this introverted and gentle child would eventually accept the past and walk into a brighter future.

But that day would never come.

Dyrroth, the Prince of the Abyss, led his Abyssal legions through the Moonlit Forest to attack the Moniyan Empire. In response, the Church of Light recruited demon hunters to prepare for the oncoming war. Seeing Granger unsettled by this, the priest let him take a leave from the monastery to decide his future. Whether he chose to remain a demon hunter or not, the monastery would always be his home.

But when Granger returned to the monastery, he saw only burning ruins and the priest lying in a pool of blood—the demons had already struck.

Whatever choice he made no longer held any meaning.

The priest's hand still held the violin bow. Granger could almost picture the priest calmly playing his final requiem as the demons attacked. The ringing invaded his world again. But this time, there would be no Hymn of Light to soothe it. There would be no one to smile and comfort his pain, no one to play a lullaby to help him sleep. How could he silence this piercing noise... this creeping madness... this deafening rage in his chest?

Sensing the presence of a living soul, the demons stationed nearby closed in. Granger pulled out his guns and began a frenzied "performance." As the demons' wails grew louder, the sound of bullets did too. The two cacophonies intertwined into a grand requiem, drowning out the ringing in Granger's ears. He suddenly realized that for him, this was the only way to soothe the pain. Blood for blood, until all evil was dead and gone.

After that, Granger officially became a demon hunter. He named one of his guns "Dirge", and modified the other into a cannon and installed it into the priest's violin case, which he named "Requiem." He wrapped bandages around his hands to prevent the bloodshed from tainting the hands that once hoped to learn the violin. From that point on, every hunt became a requiem for the ones he lost.

The memories that had surfaced shattered once again.

Granger's attention snapped back to the present. Since setting foot in this small town, the ringing in his ears hasn't stopped, but he knew that everything would quiet down soon enough.

He crouched down and gently placed a few coins in front of the child.

As the "Ave Maria" reached its finale, the demon hunter's death sonata was about to begin.
brief: Granger, a demon hunter who walks the line between human and demon, always preferred to keep to himself. But if someone could enter his world, they would realize how terrifying it is—the incessant howls and shrill cries constantly deafening his ears and heart. When he draws his demon-devouring weapons and unleashes a hail of bullets, the agonizing howls of demons become a requiem playing in the depths of his soul. Only the intertwining of their death shrieks and the sound of gunfire can drown out the noise that torments him daily. Each shot fired by Granger is not only his performance against the Abyss, but also an expression of his lament.
blurb: A mysterious demon hunter that operates outside the conventions of the Church of Light. Always seen with a violin case in hand, he hunts down demons with his two soul-devouring weapons.

abilities.name: Capriccio
abilities.description:
Granger's unique Demon Hunting Gun and Cannon are powered by Demonic Energy. Both his weapons have a starting Energy cap of 800. His Gun restores 8% Energy per second while his Cannon restores 2% Energy per second. Each Minion / Creep kill will permanently increase the Energy cap of Granger's Gun and Cannon by 6 / 6, and instantly restore their Energy by 5% / 5%, respectively. Every kill or assist on an enemy hero will permanently increase their Energy cap by 12 and instantly restore 10% Energy.
Every 1% CD Reduction Granger gains is converted into 2 Physical Attack. Demonic Energy cost is not affected by Energy Cost Reductions.

abilities.name: Rhapsody
abilities.description:
Granger rapidly fires 6 shot(s) with his Gun, with each shot dealing 60/68/76/84/92/100 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and consuming 70 Gun Energy. The last bullet is guaranteed to Crit. While firing, Granger's Movement Speed is increased by 10%.

Granger stops firing when he runs out of Energy, or when the skill is cast again. Rhapsody has a brief cooldown and can be cast once his Gun Energy is over 420.

abilities.name: Rondo
abilities.description:
Granger uses his Demon Hunter agility to dash in the target direction, instantly restoring 15/17/19/21/23/25% Energy for his Gun.

Rondo can be cast while channeling Rhapsody. Each time Rhapsody hits an enemy, Rondo's Cooldown is reduced by 0.5s.

abilities.name: Death Sonata
abilities.description:
Granger fires his Cannon in the target direction, dealing 150/200/250 (+110% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hero hit and other targets in the blast radius. Targets hit will be briefly slowed. Granger can roll in the Joystick's direction after each shot.
Death Sonata can be cast while firing Rhapsody. Death Sonata has a brief cooldown and consumes 250 of Granger's Cannon Energy per shot.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Granger's 1st Skill to poke the enemy. When his energy gets low, use his 2nd Skill to replenish it and continue to poke with his 1st Skill.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Granger's Ultimate to poke from a safe distance and continue the attack with his 1st Skill. When the 1st Skill ends, use his Ultimate again for more damage and to reposition. If enemies get close, use his 2nd Skill to create distance and continue dealing damage with his 1st Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Granger pairs well with heroes that have strong CC abilities, such as Franco and Kaja, who can hold enemies in place for Granger's entire 1st Skill.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Granger counters squishy heroes who lack mobility, such as Chang'e and Cecilion, who have a hard time dodging his 1st Skill and are vulnerable to the high damage of his Ultimate.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Granger is countered by heroes with strong single target killing power. Despite having good mobility, Granger lacks other defensive measures. Heroes like Saber and Hayabusa can quickly get the jump on Granger and finish him off.

name: Guinevere
title: Ms. Violet
story:
The Baroque family is one of the few nobles on the Land of Dawn. The most prestigious skill of theirs, fencing, the family's forte, discourages countless opponents from even thinking about attacking. In addition, beauty and wisdom are also the most perfect genetic signs of the Baroque family, just like the eternal beauty and love of Violet.

World-famous as Baroque family's fencing is, young Guinevere doesn't like it at all. Just like other girls, she is naturally fond of gorgeous things. From youth, she was sent to the Magic Academy. Relying on her own sensitive spiritual perception and anti-gravity magic, when Guinevere was 10 years old, she successfully combined mental perception with super energy and invented multiple magic effects — magic superpower. Such a breakthrough made Guinevere more passionate about magic, and she often experimented with her new magic on her brother, Lancelot. No matter how Lancelot hides, he will be found by his sister. Therefore, Lancelot is often caught in an unknown thrill. In his childhood, his sister was always causing him a headache. But anyhow, Lancelot still loves Guinevere. He always shows a smile to his beloved sister. But every time when Lancelot thinks of his little sister's magic experiment, he would wear a bitter smile.

Recently, something has been plaguing Guinevere, making her uneasy. It is said that the Paxley nobles who have a very high magical status have proposed marriage to the Baroque family. Guinevere is undoubtedly the most suitable choice and Guinevere's father seems to be very willing with the marriage. But the reluctant Guinevere suddenly thinks of an idea — She hopes to find her brother Lancelot…
brief: As the youngest daughter of one of the few noble households in the Land of Dawn, House Baroque, she studied at the Magic Academy since she was a child, and is extremely talented in magic. The household wanted her to marry into another household with a higher status. Unwilling to be used as a political bargaining chip, Guinevere decided to seek help from her elder brother Lancelot.
blurb: Aristocratic girl with a strange temperament, loved by her elder brother Lancelot.

abilities.name: Super Magic
abilities.description:
Guinevere deals 25% extra damage to airborne enemies and deals (+80% Total Physical Attack) (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage with her Basic Attacks.
Guinevere builds Super Magic each time she deals damage. Once fully charged, her next Basic Attack becomes guided, dealing 80 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic damage on hit and restoring 80 plus 8% of her lost HP.
Enemies hit by Guinevere's skills or enhanced Basic Attack will be marked for 5s. Those with 3 marks will be knocked airborne when hit by her Violet Requiem.

abilities.name: Energy Wave
abilities.description:
Guinevere releases an energy orb in the target direction, dealing 300/345/390/435/480/525 (+125% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing enemies by 25% for 1.2s.
Successfully hitting an enemy reduces all her skill cooldowns by 1s.

abilities.name: Spatial Migration
abilities.description:
Guinevere leaps to the target location, dealing 250/280/310/340/370/400 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Enemy heroes and Creeps hit will be knocked airborne for 1s and take 125/140/155/170/185/200 (+50% Total Magic Power) additional Magic Damage.
Use Again: Guinevere blinks toward the target direction and leaves an illusion behind. If the illusion takes damage by hero, it restores Super Magic for Guinevere and explodes after 1.5s, dealing 100 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Violet Requiem
abilities.description:
Guinevere creates a force field around her, gaining Control Immunity while attacking nearby enemies 11 times within 2s, dealing 880/1100/1320 (+385% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage in total.
Airborne enemies hit will be knocked airborne again, up to 8 additional times.
abilities.flavor_text: Violet Requiem, where is my dear friend?

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Guinevere can use her 2nd Skill to knock the enemy team airborne and follow with her Ultimate to deal damage while keeping them airborne. She can then use the dash of her 2nd Skill to dodge the incoming damage, or she can choose to use her 1st Skill to deal more damage for a full damage combo.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Guinevere should use her 1st Skill and her enhanced Basic Attacks to clear out the Minions and poke enemy heroes. When enemy heroes' HP is low, user Guinevere's 2nd Skill to close in on them and knock them airborne. Follow up with her Ultimate to try to finish them off.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Guinevere works best with heroes with good single-target CC that will give her a better environment to farm and deal damage, such as Franco and Hylos.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Guinevere is strong against heroes with poor sustainability or who are simply weak in the early game. This is because Guinevere can easily deliver her poking combo and escape. Heroes like Zilong and Silvanna are good examples here.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: But Guinevere is countered by heroes with CC immunities or strong CC skills. Since she needs to chain her CC to unleash her full damage potential, such as Badang and Chou.

name: Esmeralda
title: Astrologer
story:
The astrologers, who have constantly been observing astrospace, possess the occult abilities to explain and predict everything in the world, including both about their processes and results. To become an astrologer, candidates should pass rigorous assessments, which will test both their willpower and astrological abilities. Going down the generations, the elders finally select Esmeralda, a young girl living in the Western Desert, to be a new successor in the Land of Dawn.

After becoming the successor of the astrologers, Esmeralda guards the Starmoon Casket that has been passed down for generations. With the hope of opening it and gaining the mysterious power from the ancient times, Esmeralda leaves off to the Minos Labyrinth to find secrets of the Starmoon Casket. But unfortunately, on her way to the Minos Labyrinth, the ground suddenly shakes and the desert falls into pieces, followed by a black sandstorm. All of a sudden, the Starmoon Casket opens and a stream of mysterious power fills in Esmeralda. Under the protection of the mysterious power, Esmeralda gets no harm and feels old memories flashing back through her mind. She feels the Starmoon Casket is calling for her, reminding her that Khufra, the ruthless tyrant of the Western Desert long ago, has recovered himself. Following the lead of the Starmoon Casket, Esmeralda changes direction to the deep desert, where there stands an ancient city. After the Starmoon Casket opens, two streams of power coming from it begin centering around Esmeralda - Frostmoon, enriched with magic, and Stardust, filled with great power. Impressed by the might of the Starmoon Casket, which was only spoken of in tales before, Esmeralda recalls the memories from the first generation of astrologers. When Esmeralda approaches the ancient city, she vaguely feels an unknown love story between Khufra and some astrologers. Seeing the end of their love, Esmeralda somehow feels sad and sorry. But it's her mission to seal Khufra and return the peace to the Western Desert.
brief: Born into a family of Agelta astrologers, she is the greatest astrologers on the Land of Dawn. Through the treasure star-moon box, she learned the fact that the tyrant Khufra was about to wake up. The re-sealing of Khufra became her new mission as an astrologer.
blurb: A mysterious astrologer.

abilities.name: Starmoon Casket
abilities.description:
Esmeralda manipulates Stardust and Frostmoon: Stardust deals Physical Damage while Frostmoon deals Magic Damage and gives the target a shield equal to 135% of Frostmoon's damage dealt. Each Basic Attack deals (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and 100 (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
The damage dealt by Esmeralda ignores all shield effects and gradually converts her shield into HP.

abilities.name: Frostmoon Shield
abilities.description: Esmeralda gains 400/500/600/700/800/900<scaleAP> (+150% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> Shield and 40% Movement Speed which rapidly decays over its duration for 4s. Meanwhile, she gradually transforms the shields of her nearby enemies into her own shield, capped at 50% of her Max HP.

abilities.name: Stardust Dance
abilities.description: Esmeralda waves Stardust and Frostmoon, dealing 240/280/320/360/400/440<scaleAD> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and 300/350/400/450/500/550<scaleAP> (+120% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies. Each time she deals damage to a hero, the cooldown of <highlight>Frostmoon Shield</highlight> is reduced by 1.5s (damaging non-hero units grants a 0.5s reduction) and the enemy's Movement Speed is reduced by 10% for 1.5s.

abilities.name: Falling Starmoon
abilities.description:
Esmeralda coheres the power of Astrospace into her two weapons - Stardust and Frostmoon. The longer this skill is channeled, the longer the cast range.

Use Again: Esmeralda casts Stardust at the target location, dealing 350/500/650 (+90% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, and then blinks to the target location and casts Frostmoon, dealing 350/500/650 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and immobilizing enemies in the area for 1s.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, enter the fight using Esmeralda's Ultimate, then use her 1st Skill to gain Movement Speed and steal the shields of nearby enemies, before finishing them off with her 2nd Skill and Basic Attacks.
